Our in-house legal team at a large Singapore-based tech company is overwhelmed, currently spending about 15 hours a week on routine compliance work. We need a specialist to take over the preparation of Privacy Impact Assessments (PIAs) for our data processing activities to free up internal capacity. This is a focused support role to handle the documentation and analysis, ensuring we meet our data protection obligations without slowing down product development.
Deliverable: Completed Privacy Impact Assessment documents for assigned data processing activities.

hire_title: Regulatory compliance review for a legal function
hire_description: We are a Singapore-based in-house legal department seeking an independent specialist to review our current Regulatory & Compliance workstream. The goal is to assess the robustness of our existing procedures against best practices and identify any gaps in our operational framework. You will examine our current documentation and processes to ensure they align with standard corporate governance expectations for a Singapore-headquartered organisation. Deliverable: written gap analysis and prioritised action list.

hire_title: Assess Capital Utilisation for Creative Fund
hire_description: I run a government-funded entity supporting the creative sector in Singapore. Our recent internal review found that 80% of our capital sits idle, with minimal private co-investment and heavy losses. We need a specialist to conduct a current-state assessment and estimate the national funding gap for our film, fashion, and culinary portfolios. This involves reviewing our current disbursement data to understand why capital is stuck and where the biggest gaps lie for new products. Deliverable: a written current-state assessment including the estimated funding gap and key inefficiency drivers.

hire_title: Due Diligence Check on Prospective Donor for Reputational Risk
hire_description:
A Singapore-based educational institution has received an offer for a significant financial contribution from a wealthy donor, which would include naming a building or monument after them. Before accepting, we need a thorough background check to assess reputational risk. The scope covers investigating the donor's source of wealth and any potential links to bribery, corruption, sanctions, or regulatory issues involving the individual or their immediate family. This is to prevent unwanted association with high-profile adverse findings.

Deliverable: A written due diligence report outlining the background profile, source of wealth timeline, and any adverse findings, ready for review by the Dean and Trustees.

hire_title: Financial exposure analysis for food recall insurance claim
hire_description:
A Singapore-based food supplier faces potential liability from a contaminated ingredient incident involving downstream distributors. We need a specialist to perform an exposure analysis to estimate the financial impact, using Monte Carlo simulations to model risk for board-level reporting. This analysis supports insurance recovery by quantifying first-party property damage, extra expense, and business interruption losses while mitigating third-party claim exposure.
Deliverable: written financial exposure analysis with Monte Carlo simulation results.

hire_title: Resubmit Business Interruption Claim Model for Resort
hire_description:
A Singapore-based resort group suffered significant flood damage and faces a $50 million gap between its submitted insurance claim and the insurer’s low valuation. The previous advisory firm’s business interruption analysis was rejected, and relationships with the insurer’s forensic team have deteriorated. A specialist must rebuild the business interruption financial model from scratch, ensuring it is fully substantiated and able to withstand rigorous forensic accounting scrutiny. The work requires reconciling property damage and extra expense figures to justify a higher settlement offer and avoid protracted litigation.

Deliverable: detailed, fully supported financial model of the total claim with reconciled business interruption projections.

hire_title: Insurance Policy Catalogue and Cost Analysis
hire_description:
A Singapore-based global firm is facing pressure to reduce expenses and its Chief Risk Officer needs clarity on its current insurance spend. The scope involves cataloguing existing global insurance policies to understand total premiums, coverage levels, and deductibles, then evaluating the claims history to gauge loss exposure. This is a data consolidation and review task to establish a baseline before broader strategy changes.

Deliverable: a current-state total cost of risk report with policy details and loss exposure analysis.

hire_title: Revive Business Continuity Program for Packaging Facility
hire_description: A Singapore-based global packaging company with operations across multiple sites has a legacy business continuity program that has been inactive for over a decade. The program is seen negatively by business units, and there’s no current structure or engagement. We need someone to assess the current state, design a new operational risk framework, and create a plan to re-engage site teams. The approach should use behavioral science principles and leverage technology for visibility and reporting. Deliverable: a revised business continuity framework and engagement plan for one facility.

hire_title: Develop Insurance Risk Taxonomy and Assessment
hire_description: A Singapore-based residential home insurance firm with a smart home technology capability needs to define its risk profile to meet regulatory expectations. The objective is to conduct data reviews, interviews, and workshops to build a foundational Enterprise Risk Management (ERM) risk universe. The scope focuses specifically on developing the risk assessment, risk taxonomy, and identifying the top risks requiring executive attention, aligned with COSO standards. Deliverable: a risk assessment report with a defined taxonomy and a prioritised list of 45 key risks.

hire_title: Develop Crisis Response Framework for Tech Provider
hire_description: Our Singapore-based technology services provider, with over 10,000 employees across 21 countries, lacks a formalized crisis response structure. We are currently reactive to operational disruptions and need to shift to a proactive stance. We need a specialist to design a crisis response framework that formalizes decision-making processes and incorporates intelligence gathering. This must allow us to maintain essential services to critical infrastructure clients while managing remote work and local safety compliance. Deliverable: A crisis response framework document outlining policies, decision-making protocols, and engagement strategies.

hire_title: Assess Anti-Money Laundering Compliance for Payment Operator
hire_description:
We are a Singapore-based international financial services and payment operator facing regulatory scrutiny. We need an independent specialist to conduct a targeted review of our AML compliance framework to verify it is reasonably designed to prevent, detect, and report suspicious activity. The task involves evaluating our current controls against best practices and identifying gaps without undertaking a full-scale programme overhaul.

Deliverable: written gap analysis and prioritised action list.

hire_title: Automate Charge Capture for Outpatient Clinic
hire_description: I run the revenue cycle team at a Singapore-based outpatient clinic group with 12 clinics. We’re losing about S$1.2 million annually in unbilled services because charge capture is manual and inconsistent. I need someone to assess our current billing process, map where charges are missed, and design an automated capture system using existing EHR and billing software. The goal is to capture 95% of eligible charges at point of service. Deliverable: implementation plan with workflow diagrams and integration steps.

hire_title: Legacy COBOL to Azure Cloud Migration for Rail Operations
hire_description: A Singapore-based railway operations firm is replacing an outdated AS/400-based COBOL application that is expensive to maintain and lacks reliable reporting. We need a specialist to modernize this core railcar operations system by migrating it to the Azure Cloud. The specialist will design a scalable, cloud-enabled software solution that replaces manual processes, improves data accessibility, and reduces system downtime, while ensuring zero-downtime deployment patterns for existing users. Deliverable: a fully functional, deployed Azure Cloud application for railcar operations with integrated reporting.

hire_title: Annual Budget for Food Manufacturer
hire_description: A Singapore-based food and beverage manufacturer with approximately S$400M in revenue needs to complete its annual budget. The previous planning lacked analytical support, leaving management without clear direction on product profitability. The work involves developing the operational budget, including customer and product rationalization, price increases, and manufacturing cost reductions. Specific focus is required on rolling forward standard costs to reflect past and projected inflation on critical commodities, which allows for identifying real contribution margins by product. Deliverable: a final annual budget package with updated standard costs and margin analysis.

hire_title: Review Data Rights for Loyalty Program Launch
hire_description: We run a Singapore-based sports apparel and mobile fitness app company launching a global loyalty program. We hold consumer data from multiple sources with inconsistent rights and cannot establish a Unified Consumer Profile due to regulatory hurdles. We need someone to map our existing data rights across our flows and identify permissible use cases based on contractual and consent-based modes. We specifically need help determining if we can leverage de-identification or acquire new rights to merge this data legally. Deliverable: gap analysis of current data rights and a prioritised action list for compliant data merging under PDPA.

hire_title: Due Diligence on Wealthy Donor for Educational Institution
hire_description: A Singapore-based private university is considering a major donation from a wealthy individual, with plans to name a building after them. We need someone to conduct a thorough background check on the donor and their immediate family, focusing on the source of their wealth and any links to bribery, corruption, sanctions, or regulatory violations. The review must include public records, financial disclosures, and international sources, with particular attention to money laundering, offshore structures, and associations with politically exposed persons or controversial regimes. Deliverable: detailed due diligence report with findings and risk assessment for the institution’s leadership.

hire_title: Cybersecurity Gap Assessment and Risk Register Creation
hire_description: We are a multidisciplinary law firm in Singapore supporting financial institutions. After a recent security breach, our clients require us to formalise our reporting on cybersecurity progress. We need a specialist to review our current security state against the CIS 18 Critical Security Controls framework, identify gaps, and prioritise risks. This work will inform our existing roadmap and help us meet client security requirements. Deliverable: a risk register and a prioritised gap analysis report aligned to CIS 18.

hire_title: Assess University ERP System Financial Reporting Gaps
hire_description: A Singapore-based liberal arts university is reviewing its finance infrastructure after retiring its CFO. The general ledger system has outdated configurations that hinder accurate, timely financial reporting and trend analysis. A specialist is needed to conduct a deep-dive review of the current ERP system functionality. The scope involves identifying specific gaps and issues in the accounting system setup that prevent the finance team from producing reliable data for board-level budgeting and cash flow analysis. Deliverable: A written assessment highlighting critical improvements required to the ERP configuration for accurate financial reporting.

hire_title: Loss Exposure Analysis for Food Supplier Recall Event
hire_description: A Singapore-based national food supplier faced a product recall after introducing a contaminated ingredient into its supply chain, affecting multiple downstream manufacturers. The supplier needed to assess the potential financial impact of the recall, as liability was unclear and claims were emerging. The specialist must perform a loss exposure analysis using Monte Carlo simulations to estimate financial risk, considering over 90 downstream customers. Deliverable: detailed exposure analysis report with simulation results for board-level review.

hire_title: IPO Readiness Assessment for Healthcare Facility Operator
hire_description: A Singapore-based healthcare operator managing over 150 independent living facilities is preparing for an IPO. The company lacks a common chart of accounts, standard financial reporting, and public company audit readiness. We need someone to assess the current finance and accounting processes, identify gaps in reporting, controls, and systems, and deliver a roadmap for IPO readiness. Deliverable: detailed assessment report with gap analysis and prioritised action plan.

hire_title: Rebuild business interruption claim model for flood-hit resort
hire_description: We own a destination resort in Singapore that suffered significant damage from a severe flood event. Our previous insurance claim approach stalled, with the insurer’s valuation sitting $60 million below our submitted amount and talks heading toward litigation. I need a forensic accountant to independently review the property damage and extra expense figures, but the priority is fixing the business interruption measurement. The previous analysis needs to be completely reworked into a robust financial model that can withstand the scrutiny of the insurer’s forensic accountants and justify a higher settlement. Deliverable: a fully supported financial model and valuation report for the business interruption and extra expense claim components.

hire_title: Review Global Insurance Program for Cost Savings
hire_description: A Singapore-based multinational corporation is reviewing its global insurance program to reduce costs under pressure to cut expenses. We need someone to audit our existing insurance policies, map total premium, coverage, and deductible levels, and analyze claims history to assess loss exposure. This includes evaluating our captive insurance company’s utilization and efficiency. Deliverable: comprehensive report with total cost of risk analysis, utilization review findings, and actionable recommendations for cost reduction.

hire_title: Design Operational Risk Framework for Packaging Firm
hire_description:
A Singapore-based global packaging company with 80 facilities in eight countries needs to revive its neglected operational risk programme. The previous continuity efforts had stalled for over a decade, leaving the organisation vulnerable to increased regulatory scrutiny. The specialist must design a new programme structure and frameworks using behavioral science principles to re-engage staff and integrate technology for better reporting visibility.

Deliverable: A new programme structure and frameworks incorporating behavioral science and technology integration.

hire_title: ERM Risk Assessment for Singapore Insurance Firm
hire_description: Build a foundational Enterprise Risk Management (ERM) program for a Singapore-based insurance firm operating smart home technology capabilities. Conduct data reviews and workshops to identify, analyze, and prioritize risks in line with COSO standards, specifically targeting the regulatory requirements unique to the local insurance industry. Deliverable: written risk assessment and risk universe taxonomy.

hire_title: Design Crisis Response Framework for Technology Services Provider
hire_description: A Singapore-based global technology services provider with over 10,000 employees and 80+ offices worldwide is seeking to move from reactive to proactive crisis management. The company experienced operational disruptions during the pandemic and lacks a formal structure to respond to crises. We need someone to design a crisis response framework that includes decision-making protocols, intelligence gathering processes, and initial policies to enable remote work and compliance with local safety regulations. Deliverable: a documented crisis response framework with policies, decision-making structure, and a 3-year maturity roadmap.

hire_title: Develop data and AI blueprint for credit union member segmentation
hire_description: A Singapore-based credit union with over 100,000 members needs to enhance its member segmentation strategy using data and AI. The work involves developing a comprehensive Data and AI Blueprint that aligns with business objectives, analyzing the existing data infrastructure, and identifying opportunities for actionable insights. Scope includes assessing the current environment and outlining how to leverage AWS for secure data centralization and advanced analytics to uncover hidden patterns in demographic, transactional, and behavioral data. Deliverable: written Data and AI Blueprint document outlining the strategy and infrastructure recommendations.

hire_title: Design Power BI Dashboard for Nursing Visits
hire_description: I run a private duty nursing agency with 12 offices and we need to better manage our staff across home visits. Currently, we pull data manually from multiple sources to check staffing needs and visit trends, which is slow and error-prone. I need a specialist to build a Power BI solution that syncs with our existing ERP and external billing system to visualize this data. Specifically, the dashboard must track staffing requirements based on visit volume and highlight trends in missed or cancelled visits to help us identify coordination inefficiencies. Deliverable: a working Power BI dashboard connecting to ERP and billing data with visualisations for staffing and visit trends.

hire_title: Review Real Estate Restructuring for State Transfer Tax Implications
hire_description: A Singapore-based private equity firm is restructuring the real estate holdings of one of its portfolio companies, involving distributions and contributions of property to the ultimate entity, followed by a lease-back to the operating company. The firm believes the transaction is tax-free for federal income tax purposes and assumes real estate transfer tax implications will be minimal. However, state-level transfer tax rules vary, and exemptions are not universally available. We need someone to review the restructuring plan for real estate transfer tax implications in relevant jurisdictions, identify any states with limited exemptions, and assess potential tax liabilities. Deliverable: written assessment of transfer tax risks and recommendations to restructure steps to minimise tax exposure.

hire_title: Develop Strategic Initiatives Plan for Medical Center Savings
hire_description: A Singapore-based medical centre aims to achieve S$7.7 million in annual operational savings. We need a specialist to identify and structure specific strategic initiatives that will drive this target. The work involves analysing current operations to pinpoint areas for cost reduction and efficiency gains, then outlining the specific actions required to realise the S$7.7 million in savings. Deliverable: a strategic initiatives plan detailing the scope, estimated impact, and implementation steps for achieving the savings target.

hire_title: Architect cloud ERP data flow for new subsidiary
hire_description:
We are a Singapore-based industrial services company recently carved out from a larger parent. Our current systems are fragmented and cannot handle real-time billing, leaving us with unbilled revenue. We need an expert to design the data process flow and controls for our Acumatica ERP implementation. Focus on ensuring the system captures revenue accurately so we can invoice immediately upon completion of work, avoiding cash flow gaps. The solution must support our rapid growth strategy without requiring heavy on-premise server maintenance.
Deliverable: documented data architecture and control design for Acumatica.

hire_title: CIS Controls Gap Assessment for Law Firm
hire_description: Assess the information security posture of a Singapore-based multidisciplinary law firm that recently experienced a security breach. The firm lacks internal security leadership and faces strict requirements from financial institution clients to report on cybersecurity progress. We need a specialist to review the current security state and existing initiatives, identify gaps against the CIS 18 Critical Security Controls framework, and prioritise risks. The review must also consider how to coordinate with vendors to meet implementation deadlines for new tools. Deliverable: a gap analysis report with a prioritised risk register and updated roadmap milestones.

hire_title: Design Pre-Authorization Automation Workflow for Medical Office
hire_description: We are a Singapore-based medical office support firm handling pre-certification and insurance follow-up for local hospitals. Our manual pre-authorization process is labour-intensive, leading to high patient denial rates and slow processing times. We need a specialist to design a Robotic Process Automation (RPA) workflow using UiPath that automates procedure evaluation, authorization initiation, and status updates. The workflow must integrate securely with our existing Electronic Medical Record (EMR) platform via a .NET-based web portal hosted on Azure. The goal is to reduce manual workflow volume by 30% immediately and 60% upon maturity, minimising denials and improving provider efficiency. Deliverable: a documented RPA workflow design and integration plan for the pre-authorization process.

hire_title: Redesign Distribution Network for Growth
hire_description: A Singapore-based $80 million retailer with 150 years of operations plans to expand significantly over the next five years and needs to adapt its warehouse network to support new stores. We need someone to analyze the current network using historical demand, customer, inventory, and transportation data, and model different expansion strategies. The specialist will develop a 5-year plan for adding warehouses in sync with store openings, including financial projections for costs and profit margins. Deliverable: 5-year network expansion plan with cost and margin forecasts.

hire_title: Review and Improve University ERP Financial Reporting System
hire_description: A Singapore-based liberal arts university with over 150 years of operation is facing financial instability due to outdated accounting practices and inefficient financial reporting. The institution needs someone to assess its current ERP system’s financial reporting configuration, identify gaps in general ledger functionality, and recommend improvements to enable timely and accurate financial data. The specialist will focus on the finance and accounting module, evaluating system setup, reporting workflows, and data integrity. Deliverable: detailed assessment report with findings and prioritised recommendations for enhancing financial reporting accuracy and timeliness.

hire_title: Audit Social Welfare Rights Awareness in Rural Community Groups
hire_description: We operate community self-help groups in rural Singapore supporting marginalised women and elders. Our groups run livelihood projects, but many members remain unaware of their rights or available government social welfare schemes. We need an independent specialist to review our current outreach and training materials to identify where information gaps leave members missing out on support. The work involves assessing how effectively we explain these systems in plain language and evaluating if our delivery methods reach those with lower literacy. Deliverable: a gap analysis report on awareness levels and a prioritised list of recommended changes to our training content.

hire_title: Design Village Development Committee Structure for Rural Community
hire_description: We are a Singapore-based non-profit focused on community-driven development in rural areas. We need someone to design a village development committee (VDC) structure for a new community project. The VDC should include representation from women, youth, and senior citizens, and be set up to identify and lead local development initiatives. The specialist must define roles, responsibilities, decision-making processes, and how the committee will engage with households. Deliverable: detailed VDC structure document with governance model and operational guidelines.

hire_title: Assess IT Carbon Footprint for Net Zero Goals
hire_description: A Singapore-based global consulting firm is working to reduce its IT-related carbon emissions as part of its net zero commitment. They need someone to conduct a lifecycle-based carbon footprint assessment of their IT estate, focusing on on-premise data centers, application portfolio, and third-party contracts. The assessment should identify key emission sources and evaluate efficiency gaps in energy use and renewable energy adoption. Deliverable: detailed report with carbon footprint analysis, key findings, and actionable recommendations.

hire_title: Test Private 5G Network for Autonomous Guided Vehicle Use Case
hire_description: I run the digital transformation team at a Singapore-based airport operator, and we’re exploring private 5G to improve tarmac operations. We need someone to test a real-world use case: deploying an Autonomous Guided Vehicle (AGV) for tarmac inspections using a private 5G network. The specialist will set up the network, run performance tests under different conditions, and compare it with existing radio technologies. They’ll document latency, coverage, and reliability. Deliverable: technical report with test results, performance analysis, and recommendations for next steps.

hire_title: Generative AI Governance and Strategy for Public Sector
hire_description: We are a Singapore-based statutory board looking to understand the potential of generative AI to improve our internal municipal services and business processes. Following the rapid rise of AI tools, we need an expert to help us rethink our operations, focusing on secure and ethical implementation. Your task is to develop an initial generative AI governance model and a scalable foundational architecture that aligns with our broader digital transformation goals. This includes mapping practical internal use cases, such as streamlining HR or procurement queries, without drawing on external public data. We need pragmatic guidance to ensure the architecture can scale as use cases grow, avoiding the need to reinvent solutions for every new pilot. Deliverable: comprehensive AI governance framework document and a scalable reference architecture for internal generative AI pilots.

hire_title: Optimise Field Service Route Planning
hire_description: I run operations at a Singapore-based water utility with a 1,200-person field force. Our legacy systems are outdated, leading to inefficient travel and lack of visibility. We need a specialist to review our current routing logic and propose a method for optimising routes using traffic and roadworks data to cut vehicle journeys and carbon emissions. Deliverable: A route optimisation model and implementation plan.

hire_title: Normalize Profitability Data Sources for Investment Management Firm
hire_description: I run the financial planning and analysis team at a Singapore-based global investment management firm, and we’re struggling with profitability reporting that’s too slow and inconsistent. Our data comes from over 50 sources, manually reconciled in Excel, and takes months to process—by then, it’s outdated. We need someone to assess these data sources, clean and normalize them, and create a single, trusted source of truth for profitability calculations. This includes aligning data definitions, removing duplicates, and establishing consistent rules for revenue and cost allocation. Deliverable: cleansed and standardized dataset with documented data governance rules.

hire_title: Develop AI Model for Work-Related Expense Claim Substantiation
hire_description: A Singapore-based tax authority is seeking to improve the efficiency of processing work-related expense (WRE) claims by leveraging artificial intelligence. We need someone to develop a machine learning model that can automatically assess WRE claims and flag only the highest-risk submissions for human review. The model should use historical claim data and apply natural language processing and computer vision to evaluate supporting documents. Deliverable: a working AI model prototype with documentation on data inputs, algorithm logic, and risk-scoring criteria.

hire_title: Design Smart Waste Management System with Sensors and Analytics
hire_description: A Singapore-based city council is upgrading its waste collection operations to reduce costs and improve efficiency. The council needs someone to design a smart waste management system using IoT sensors on recycling bins to track fill levels, and integrate this data with existing city operations. The system must support route optimization for collection crews and reduce unnecessary pickups. Deliverable: a detailed system design document including sensor placement plan, data integration approach, and route optimization logic.

hire_title: Back-office process standardization assessment
hire_description: We are a Singapore-based global wholesale distributor facing margin pressures while planning for decade-long growth. Our back-office functions suffer from fragmentation, lack of process standardization, and inefficient execution across roles. We need a specialist to review our current operating model, identify areas for automation and standardization, and assess potential cost savings within a single functional area (such as finance or procurement). Deliverable: written gap analysis and prioritised action list for back-office efficiencies.

hire_title: Pilot GenAI-Enhanced SDLC for One Banking Line of Business
hire_description: A Singapore-based global bank wants to improve software delivery for one of its digital banking lines of business. Teams currently use different tools and processes, leading to miscommunication and inefficiency. We need someone to run an eight-week proof of concept using an AI-enabled software development life cycle (SDLC) tool to unify workflows across product owners, architects, developers, and QA engineers. The specialist will help adapt the tool to the team’s existing processes, focusing on automating documentation, test case generation, and user story creation. Deliverable: report on the pilot’s impact, including productivity gains, collaboration improvements, and recommended next steps.

hire_title: Design AI Governance Framework for Biotech R&D Operations
hire_description: We’re a Singapore-based biotech company focused on genetic medicine, and we’re launching an AI initiative to boost R&D and clinical operations. We need someone to design a governance framework for AI tools in these areas, ensuring responsible use while aligning with our goals to reduce time to market and lower costs. The framework must include guiding principles, risk assessment processes, and a governance council structure with roles from legal, compliance, and IT. It should also define how AI capabilities—summarize, generate, or search—will be applied. Deliverable: documented AI governance framework with policies, procedures, and a governance council charter.

hire_title: AV Fleet Data Platform Architecture Review
hire_description:
We are a Singapore-based public mobility agency piloting a small fleet of autonomous vehicles to serve seniors in one residential district. The vehicles generate significant raw telemetry data including velocity, location, and object detection logs. We need an independent specialist to review our current data ingestion strategy and design a data platform architecture capable of timestamping, transforming, and combining this high-volume streaming data with external contextual datasets like weather. The solution must enable role-based querying for engineers to identify safety events such as hard braking or near-misses.

Deliverable: technical architecture specification and data flow design document.

hire_title: Build AI-Powered Safety Issue Alerting Model for Automotive OEM
hire_description: A Singapore-based automotive original equipment manufacturer is improving its vehicle safety compliance after a government-mandated improvement process. They need someone to build an issue alerting model (IAM) that uses data from service histories, customer feedback, and safety incident logs to generate prioritized, risk-ranked alerts. The specialist must run text classification models on unstructured data using machine learning, process it on a big data platform, and integrate it into a dashboard for the safety office. Deliverable: working IAM system with integrated dashboard and documented data processing pipeline.

hire_title: Evaluate and consolidate dual B2B dealer ordering platforms
hire_description: We are a Singapore-based heavy equipment manufacturer with 300+ global dealers. Currently, dealers use two distinct, separate platforms for ordering, creating fragmented processes and compatibility issues. We need a specialist to evaluate both existing B2B commerce platforms against scalability and integration requirements. The goal is to determine the best path for consolidation into a single, unified cloud-based system that improves the dealer experience. Deliverable: written evaluation report with a consolidation strategy and technical recommendation.

hire_title: Inventory Target Optimization for Mining MRO Assets
hire_description:
We are a Singapore-based mining operation facing surplus MRO inventory that ties up working capital and misaligned stock levels causing downtime. We need a specialist to analyze our historical demand, current lead times, and supplier delivery performance to determine optimal reorder points and maximum inventory targets for our critical spare parts. The goal is to reduce excess stock while maintaining high service reliability.

Deliverable: A data-driven inventory optimization model with calculated target levels for key MRO items.

hire_title: Develop Accounting Framework for Sponsorship and Lease Agreements
hire_description: A Singapore-based non-profit organising a major multi-day sporting event is preparing its first audited financial statements under US GAAP. The organisation has grown rapidly from a small team to over 1,000 staff and has entered numerous complex sponsorship and vendor lease arrangements. The finance team needs guidance on applying US GAAP to these specific contracts, which require significant technical judgement. The specialist must review the agreement structures and develop a roadmap for accounting treatment, including illustrative use-case scenarios and tailored position papers. Contract review templates should also be created for future similar agreements to standardise the process. Deliverable: A technical accounting roadmap with position papers and contract review templates for sponsorship and lease arrangements.

hire_title: Qualitative Synthesis for Restaurant Industry Survey
hire_description: We are an independent restaurant advocacy foundation in Singapore and we are updating our annual industry report. Our quantitative survey data is solid, but it lacks the nuance of chef experiences. We need a specialist to use Generative AI tools to synthesize data from roundtable discussions and interviews conducted across multiple cities. The goal is to identify common themes and contrasts in independent operator experiences to provide context to our numerical findings. Deliverable: a thematic synthesis document linking qualitative insights to survey data.

hire_title: Fan Research and Digital Strategy Roadmap
hire_description: I lead digital products at a Singapore-based professional sports league. Our current app only streams games, but fans want personalized highlights and real-time stats, and we need a strategy to grow League Pass subscriptions. I need a specialist to conduct proprietary fan research and competitive benchmarking to inform a multiyear digital strategy. This involves analyzing how to keep fans within our ecosystem to unlock first-party data insights. Deliverable: a multiyear digital strategy document and product roadmap.

hire_title: Legal Spend Strategy Review and Optimisation Plan
hire_description:
We are a Singapore-based legal department looking to optimise external legal spend and manage costs more effectively. We need a specialist to analyse our current spend, risk, and complexity data to identify areas where we can cut routine costs without compromising quality on significant matters.
The work involves reviewing our existing legal spend strategy, benchmarking against market rates, and redesigning the approach to better allocate resources. You will apply data-driven methods to pinpoint inefficiencies and recommend specific structural changes to our outside counsel management and pricing models.
Deliverable: a legal spend optimisation plan with clear recommendations for cost reduction and resource reallocation.

hire_title: Assess Demand Barriers for Low-Carbon Innovation in Automotive Sector
hire_description: I run sustainability strategy at a Singapore-based automotive manufacturer and need to understand why our low-carbon innovations, like lightweight composites and electric drivetrains, aren’t scaling beyond pilot projects. I want someone to review the market barriers—especially demand-side risks, fragmented supply chains, and cost premiums—using the Market Forming Interventions (MFI) Toolkit. They should interview 3-5 key stakeholders, including suppliers and customers, and map the gaps in adoption. Deliverable: a 15-20 page report identifying the top three demand barriers and recommending two targeted interventions to accelerate market uptake.

hire_title: Prepare Cultural and Biological Surveys for Mine Tailings Site
hire_description: Conduct cultural resources and biological surveys for a former silver mine site in Singapore requiring remediation of 26,000 cubic yards of loose tailings. We need a specialist to assess the site for archaeological and ecological assets before clean-up begins to ensure preservation of critical habitats. This work supports the regulatory compliance and community notification aspects of the voluntary clean-up project. Deliverable: a completed survey report documenting cultural and biological resources with recommendations for minimising disturbance.

hire_title: Assess Economic Impact of Offshore Wind Project in Akita Prefecture
hire_description: We are a Singapore-based renewable energy development firm planning a 200 MW offshore wind project off the coast of Singapore. We need someone to assess the potential gross value added and local employment impact of this project using input–output analysis and a validated offshore wind cost model. The work includes reviewing project data, applying the model, and estimating economic ripple effects. Deliverable: report with GVA and job creation estimates under current and enhanced local participation scenarios.

hire_title: Historic and Cultural Impact Assessment for Offshore Wind Site
hire_description: We are the regulatory body overseeing the development of an 800-MW offshore wind facility in Singapore. Before we can issue construction approval, we need a specialist to complete the Section 106 consultation process for our Environmental Impact Statement. This involves assessing historic and cultural impacts from construction, operation, and decommissioning phases. You will coordinate with heritage authorities and document findings to support our decision-making. Deliverable: completed Section 106 consultation report integrated into the EIS.

hire_title: Develop Stormwater Pollution Prevention Plan for Abandoned Mine Site
hire_description: We manage a former mining site in Singapore that has been abandoned and is now leaking contaminants into nearby waterways, posing risks to human health and ecosystems. We need someone to develop and implement a Stormwater Pollution Prevention Plan for this site, using Best Management Practices such as erosion control blankets, straw mats, hydroseeding with local vegetation, and rip-rap barriers. The specialist will also use drone technology to monitor the site’s topography and ensure ongoing risk management. Deliverable: completed Stormwater Pollution Prevention and Construction Quality Assurance Plans with implementation recommendations.

hire_title: Environmental Impact Assessment for Gas Pipeline
hire_description: A Singapore-based power plant developer is constructing a natural gas pipeline to feed a new facility that will double current fuel efficiency. Under local standards, new contract costs cannot be deferred, which creates a deficit as contract volume grows. We need a specialist to perform trial calculations under IFRS 17 to validate the feasibility of deferring new contract costs, specifically advertising expenses, over the policy period. The scope includes testing various deferral patterns to confirm the standard aligns with the company's actual financial state. Deliverable: a written report on the trial calculations confirming the deferral approach and its impact on periodic profit and loss.

hire_title: Design Customer-Centric Wealth Advisory Model
hire_description: A Singapore-based private bank wants to shift from product-centric to customer-centric wealth advisory services. The bank has seen rising client expectations for personalized, goal-based advice and integrated digital experiences. They need someone to design a new advisory model focused on client goals, using insights from client interviews and data analysis. The specialist will map current client journeys, identify gaps in personalization, and propose a goal-based advisory framework that aligns with client needs and digital delivery. Deliverable: a documented customer-centric advisory model with key recommendations for implementation.

hire_title: Digital Customer Journey Mapping for Insurer Product Launch
hire_description: We are a Singapore-based life insurer seeking to launch a simplified annuity product with a new digital engagement model. We need an expert to map the customer journey for our target demographics, analyzing external market data to identify the addressable market and opportunity. The work involves developing persona-based journey maps and reviewing competitor landscapes in the InsurTech space to inform our product concept. Deliverable: executive-level business concept deck with final journey maps, opportunity analysis, and launch plan considerations.

hire_title: Cloud-First Strategy and Operating Model Design for Insurance NewCo
hire_description:
A Singapore-based global life insurance group with over S$5 billion in annual revenue is preparing to spin off its local life and annuity business into a standalone NewCo. The mandate is to establish a future-state, cloud-first insurer that simplifies the landscape and reduces complexity from process, technology, and people perspectives. The new entity must be designed to be a low-cost provider in a low-growth environment, focusing on simplicity, transparency, and trust.

The specialist needs to design the enterprise strategy and lean, agile operating model for this single business unit. This involves defining guiding principles for cloud-first adoption and cost optimization, mapping the business architecture across the value chain (including finance, actuarial, and distribution), and creating a roadmap for separating essential systems and operations from the parent company. The work requires aligning stakeholders on a strategy that enables significant annual expense savings through technology optimization.

Deliverable: detailed enterprise technology and operational strategy report with a cloud-first implementation roadmap and lean operating model design.

hire_title: Design Change Sentiment Dashboard for Workforce Adoption
hire_description:
We are a Singapore-based professional services firm with over 300,000 staff currently undergoing a global strategy refresh. We need to track how employees are adopting the new ways of working and identify where engagement is dropping. The work involves using pre-built assessments in eight languages to gather data on awareness, sentiment, and behavioral adoption. You will analyse this data to identify key success factors such as leadership commitment and preparedness, and pinpoint specific groups or hotspots that are off-track. This analysis must be visualised in interactive dashboards that allow business leaders to drill down into team-level responses and understand behavioral profiles.

Deliverable: A set of interactive dashboards displaying aggregated sentiment and adoption data, with the ability to drill down to team level.

hire_title: Adobe Commerce Migration Architecture Plan
hire_description: Our pet recovery D2C platform runs on legacy, non-cloud infrastructure that cannot scale with growing demand. We are migrating to a cloud-based Adobe Commerce stack and need a specialist to define the technical migration strategy. The scope covers mapping the current data structure for migration, outlining API development requirements, and designing the back-end integration points for supply chain and financial reconciliation systems. Deliverable: a detailed migration architecture plan and integration roadmap.

hire_title: Design Data Matching Rules for Child Welfare System
hire_description: We are a Singapore-based statutory board responsible for child protection services. We’re struggling to connect data across multiple departments—social services, case management, and community support—because each system uses different formats and identifiers. We need someone to design data matching rules using fields like postcode, age, gender, and family relationships to link records from different sources. The goal is to create a unified view of families in need for early intervention. Deliverable: documented data matching logic and sample integration rules.

hire_title: Data Quality Assessment for Social Services Case Files
hire_description: A Singapore-based local council is struggling to provide timely support because resident data is scattered across multiple disconnected case management systems. Staff currently react to immediate needs rather than planning proactively, as they lack a holistic view of households. The work involves auditing the data collection processes for adult, children, and homelessness services to identify gaps in accuracy and consistency. This review will determine how to cleanse and structure this data to support future analytics. Deliverable: a written report detailing data quality gaps and a prioritised list of cleansing actions.

hire_title: Review enterprise AI governance and compliance framework
hire_description: We are a Singapore-based professional services organisation aiming to expand our AI capabilities across local operations while meeting strict regulatory requirements. We need a specialist to review our existing Responsible AI framework and data lineage controls for alignment with Singapore's PDPA and MAS guidelines, specifically focusing on governance for autonomous workflows. The work involves auditing current policy gaps, mapping data flows through our Microsoft Fabric and Copilot environments, and recommending concrete adjustments to ensure auditability and trust. Deliverable: written gap analysis and prioritised action list for governance compliance.

hire_title: Map AI Use Cases to Business Goals for Firm
hire_description: A Singapore-based professional services firm is managing proof-of-concept fatigue from scattered AI initiatives across its global operations. We need a specialist to map potential AI use cases against our core business goals to harmonize efforts, optimize performance, and eliminate low-impact projects. The specialist must review the current landscape of internal AI deployments and reimage workflows around AI to focus on high-value opportunities. Deliverable: prioritised list of strategic AI use cases aligned to business outcomes.

hire_title: Independent Review of AI Governance Framework
hire_description: I run the AI governance function at a Singapore-based global biopharmaceutical company, and we need someone to conduct an independent review of our current AI governance framework. We’ve developed principles around transparency, fairness and human-centricity, but leadership wants assurance we’re managing AI risks consistently across projects. The specialist will use the global Responsible AI framework to assess our existing framework, interview key stakeholders, review documentation, and evaluate a sample of key AI projects (like forecasting and adverse event tracking). Deliverable: written assessment report highlighting gaps and recommendations for improvement.

hire_title: AI Chatbot Design for IT Vendor Management
hire_description: We are a Singapore-based IT services firm managing over 15,000 vendors across multiple regions. Our current vendor query process is slow, with responses taking several days, and we struggle to handle queries in 14 languages, leading to low satisfaction. We need an expert to design the specification for an on-premise, multi-lingual AI chatbot that can resolve vendor queries in real-time. The solution must integrate with our enterprise applications and support secure access via multi-factor authentication. Deliverable: technical design document and functional requirements specification for the AI chatbot.

hire_title: Map AI Compliance Controls to Internal Workflows
hire_description: We are a Singapore-based technology product organisation building AI features within Microsoft 365. We need to streamline evidence generation for new products by mapping over 80 certification frameworks, including ISO 42001 and over 500 specific controls, to our existing engineering and audit workflows. The specialist will analyse our current control footprint and define the essential change control configurations needed to embed compliance by design, ensuring automated compliance checks are integrated from the start of the development lifecycle. Deliverable: a written gap analysis and prioritised action list for control mapping and workflow embedding.

hire_title: Design Responsible AI Policy and Governance Framework
hire_description: I run the AI governance programme at a Singapore-based engineering consultancy with over 20,000 global employees. We’re committed to ethical AI and need to prepare for the EU AI Act and similar regulations. I need someone to help design a responsible AI policy and governance framework tailored to our risk appetite. This includes defining AI for our organisation, curating our AI risk appetite, drafting the policy, and designing an inventory process to track AI systems and models like GPT-4 and linear regression. Deliverable: comprehensive responsible AI policy document and governance framework, including risk appetite definition and inventory management process.

hire_title: Audit Journal Entry Data Analytics Assessment
hire_description: I manage audit quality for a Singapore-based multinational and need to move beyond sampling for our financial statement audits. Our current process relies on manual reviews of a small sample of journal entries, but we want to analyze 100% of our transaction data to identify outliers and inconsistencies, such as breaks in the flow from revenue to cash. I need a specialist to configure a data analytics workflow on our existing audit platform to process this full dataset. Deliverable: a configuration report showing the correlation analysis and identified outliers.

hire_title: Develop Social and Environmental Impact Assessment Framework
hire_description:
I run a small-scale electric motorsport series in Singapore and need to manage the social and environmental impact of our temporary race events. We require a specialist to tailor the World Bank’s Environmental and Social Framework to suit our transient, small-scale operations in diverse locations. The scope includes adapting the framework to handle variable risk profiles, such as arctic versus desert environments, and creating supporting templates to ensure consistent, high-quality outputs regardless of who performs the assessment. The framework must remain flexible enough for use in any future race location.
Deliverable: A customised SEIA framework and a set of supporting assessment templates.

hire_title: Design Mobile-First KYC Process for Digital Bank
hire_description: We’re launching a mobile-only bank in Singapore and need to redesign the account opening process to be faster and more user-friendly. We want to use digital identity verification, like selfie-based e-KYC, to reduce steps and time. The goal is to open accounts in under 10 minutes, compared to 20-30 minutes at traditional banks. We’ll need to ensure compliance with MAS and PDPA standards, and integrate with existing identity verification systems. Deliverable: a mobile-first KYC workflow design with security and compliance controls, tested for usability.

hire_title: NLP Model for Agent Call Analysis
hire_description: Our phone sales team lacks a formulaic way to analyse why some agents outperform others; current reviews rely on subjective sampling. We need an NLP specialist to build a model that extracts qualitative insights from unstructured call data—specifically topics, talk tracks, and follow-up behaviours—while handling noise from legacy systems. The model must link these qualitative signals to structured CRM and outcome metrics to identify high-performing behaviours. Deliverable: a trained NLP model and data linking script.

hire_title: Proof of Concept for Blockchain Blood Supply Tracking
hire_description: A Singapore-based blood services organisation needs a blockchain specialist to design a proof of concept for 'vein-to-vein' traceability. This system must integrate with IoT sensors to log GPS location and temperature data, ensuring an immutable audit trail. Deliverable: a working proof of concept model demonstrating real-time traceability and data integrity.

hire_title: Design Customer Journey Map for B2B Chemical Supplier
hire_description: A Singapore-based chemical manufacturing company serving B2B clients in packaging and infrastructure markets wants to improve its customer experience. The specialist will identify key touchpoints, pain points, and moments that matter, then create a visual journey map highlighting gaps and improvement opportunities. Deliverable: technical architecture document for the Databricks data products supporting third-party risk assessment.

hire_title: Data Maturity Assessment for Retail Customer Data

hire_description: Our global finance team spends too much time on manual forecasts using outdated spreadsheets and data from hundreds of sources. We need to reduce this workload and improve accuracy. hire_title: Data governance and predictive model for social services
hire_description: I work for a Singapore-based town council delivering social services in a high-deprivation estate. We hold resident records across several disconnected case management systems, so we struggle to spot at-risk households early and tend to react to crises instead of preventing them. I need an independent data specialist to map our current data sources, define a unified schema for adult and child services, and build a predictive model that flags high-risk cases at least six months before a crisis occurs. Deliverable: a technical specification for the data integration and a working predictive model prototype.

hire_title: Design Behavioral Health Data Reporting Interface for State Agency
hire_description: A Singapore-based public health authority is upgrading its behavioral health data reporting system. The legacy system causes reporting delays and inconsistent data, making it hard to track service outcomes. They need someone to design a user-friendly, model-driven application interface for internal staff that simplifies data entry, improves accuracy, and integrates with existing systems. The interface must support standardized fields, clear navigation, and real-time submission tracking. Deliverable: prototype of the internal staff interface with wireframes and user flow documentation.

hire_title: TANF Policy Impact Model and User Guide
hire_description: We are a Singapore-based statutory board managing a temporary assistance programme for over 30,000 low-income families. We need a specialist to build a machine learning model using our historical recipient data to predict household success and simulate the impact of policy changes, such as localised eligibility thresholds or extended childcare benefits. This will replace manual spreadsheets and help us understand how specific rule changes affect retention. Deliverable: a working prediction tool and a user manual for legislative staff.

hire_title: Predictive Maintenance Data Pipeline for Radar Assets
hire_description: We manage critical radar infrastructure in Singapore and face high operational costs due to reactive maintenance. We need a specialist to design a predictive maintenance data pipeline that integrates millions of records from disparate systems, using natural language processing to structure unstructured maintenance logs. The goal is to identify root causes of equipment failures and enable remote monitoring of sensor data to predict faults 3 to 7 days in advance, reducing manual site visits and improving planned maintenance accuracy. Deliverable: functional data pipeline architecture and prototype model for predicting equipment failures.

hire_title: Design Month-End Close Process for Reinsurer
hire_description: We are a Singapore-based life reinsurance startup preparing for launch. We need a specialist to design the month-end close process for our finance team. This includes setting up the workflow within SAP S/4HANA and creating the necessary process documentation. The goal is to ensure we can handle complex reinsurance deals efficiently from day one. Deliverable: written close checklist and process manual.

hire_title: Design Cash Leadership Office for Procurement Function
hire_description: A Singapore-based pharmaceutical company is overhauling its working capital to fund R&D amid an upcoming patent cliff. The Treasury team needs to establish a cash leadership office (CLO) to improve cash flow, starting with the Procurement function. The specialist must design the CLO’s governance structure, define cash flow KPIs for procurement, and map key processes to identify improvement levers. The work must align with the company’s capital allocation strategy and support a shift from P&L-centric to cash-focused operations. Deliverable: a detailed CLO design document for procurement, including governance model, KPIs, and process improvement recommendations.

hire_title: Quote-to-Cash Process Maturity Assessment
hire_description: I run operations for a Singapore-based SaaS observability firm with 15,000 global customers. We are facing significant manual overhead in quoting, low integration between upstream and downstream data sets, and extended transaction times. I need an independent specialist to conduct a maturity assessment against peers, review our current quote-to-cash technology architecture, and identify root causes for these inefficiencies. We are moving from a subscription to a consumption model, so we need to streamline the core quoting process and establish a common data foundation. Deliverable: assessment report with prioritised action list for process and architecture improvements.

hire_title: Develop Synergy Business Case for Logistics Carve-Out Integration
hire_description: We are a Singapore-based logistics group acquiring a carve-out business and need someone to help develop a detailed business case for one specific synergy initiative. The work includes identifying and quantifying cost savings, outlining one-time and ongoing costs, and creating a high-level roadmap with milestone timelines and effort estimates for the initiative. Deliverable: a standalone business case document for the synergy opportunity.

hire_title: Review Revenue Projections for Smart Home Device Company
hire_description: A Singapore-based special purpose acquisition company (SPAC) is considering acquiring a smart home technology firm with distribution in North America. The SPAC needs an independent review of the target’s top-line revenue projections to assess commercial viability. The specialist must analyze market growth, product volumes, R&D requirements, and cross-selling opportunities, comparing them to historical sales and forecast data. Deliverable: detailed report identifying a potential 25% revenue shortfall and outlining key assumptions at risk.

hire_title: Assess Separation Complexity for One Business Unit Carve-Out
hire_description: A Singapore-based oil and gas services provider is evaluating the potential sale of one of its three global business units. We need someone to assess the operational, financial and back-office dependencies for that single unit, including shared services, cost allocation, headcount, contracts, technology and facilities. The specialist must map all critical entanglements and identify separation risks, then outline service replacement needs and mitigation strategies. Deliverable: a modular assessment report for that one business unit, detailing separation complexity, standalone requirements and transaction perimeter considerations.

hire_title: Commercial Due Diligence for Smart Home Target
hire_description:
We are a Singapore-based special purpose acquisition company preparing to acquire a technology company specialised in smart home devices. We need a commercial assessment of the target’s business plan to verify its viability before we proceed. The core issue is that the management’s top-line projections appear optimistic; we need an independent analysis to determine if the forecasted revenue is realistic. The scope involves reviewing the target’s historical sales track record and spend, analysing market growth trends and competitive positioning, and stress-testing product volume assumptions, R&D requirements, and cross-selling opportunities. This review is critical as we suspect a potential revenue shortfall that could impact the deal structure.
Deliverable: A written report identifying specific revenue vulnerabilities, quantifying the potential gap, and providing targeted initiatives to mitigate risk.

hire_title: Carve-out assessment for single oil and gas business unit
hire_description:
I manage the business development function at a Singapore-based oil and gas services provider. We are evaluating the potential sale of one of our three business units and need a specialist to assess its separation complexity. Please review the unit's current operating model and shared support structure to identify entanglements across employees, contracts, technology, and facilities. You need to clarify unallocated costs and outline service replacement requirements to determine standalone viability.

Deliverable: A modular carve-out diligence report covering operational and financial dependencies for that specific unit, suitable for inclusion in go-to-market materials.

hire_title: Critique Opposing Expert's Loss Valuation Methodology
hire_description: We are the respondents in a high-stakes healthcare litigation where the claim is valued in the hundreds of millions. The Court has set a strict deadline for us to file a report rebutting the opposing expert’s loss opinions. We need a specialist to independently evaluate their methodology, which incorrectly relies on assumptions about our valuation models originally prepared for financial reporting. You will review the disputed models and discovery documents to identify where the opponent misinterpreted key fields and applied flawed loss calculations. You must test their approach against first principles rather than just responding point-by-point. Deliverable: a Court-ready expert report critiquing the opposing expert's loss opinions and demonstrating methodological flaws.

hire_title: Assess G&A Cost Reduction Opportunities for Cloud Service Provider
hire_description: We’re a Singapore-based managed cloud service provider facing margin pressure, and we need to reduce general and administrative (G&A) costs. We want someone to review our current G&A functions, including overhead, support staff, and external spend, to identify cost-saving opportunities. The specialist should assess current processes, benchmark against industry standards, and recommend practical, actionable reductions. Deliverable: detailed report with cost-saving recommendations for G&A, including estimated savings and implementation steps.

hire_title: Financial Forensics Review for Pharmacy Billing Firm
hire_description: A Singapore-based pharmacy billing firm sought a EUR245 million credit line extension, and lenders engaged a specialist to review its financial health. The firm was experiencing rapid liquidity loss, and the specialist must examine financial records, trace fund flows, and identify any unauthorised transfers or hidden asset movements. The review must focus on detecting fraudulent activities and verifying the accuracy of reported financials. Deliverable: detailed forensic report with findings on fund siphoning and liquidity risks.

hire_title: Assess Churn Risk and Forecast Upsell for Priority Accounts
hire_description:
I run sales at a Singapore-based data hardware and storage company facing significant churn as customers migrate to cloud solutions. We need an independent specialist to analyze our customer base and identify high-risk accounts for retention and upsell opportunities.

You will assess churn risk using defined triggers to flag priority accounts, then build cohort-based models to forecast upsell and cross-sale potential. You must also validate these model outputs by reviewing sales representative feedback or survey data to ensure accuracy.

Deliverable: a short report containing the churn risk assessment for priority accounts and the validated upsell forecast model.

hire_title: Assess Agentic AI Platform for BPO Investment
hire_description: A Singapore-based business process outsourcing company is being considered for investment. We need someone to review the technical and strategic capabilities of its agentic AI platform, including large language models, system integrations, and telemetry tools. The specialist should evaluate the AI roadmap, R&D operating model, and IP entanglement with parent units, then benchmark its market position using a functional and technical scoring model. Deliverable: detailed assessment report with risk and opportunity analysis.

hire_title: Quantify Financial Losses for Turkish Investment Expropriation Claim
hire_description: A Singapore-based commodities trading company and its Dutch affiliate, both part of a larger group, are pursuing an international arbitration claim against Turkey for expropriation of their Turkish investments. The specialist must build a multicurrency financial model using tailored valuation methodologies, incorporating long-term gas price projections and market intelligence, to withstand scrutiny in ICSID proceedings. Deliverable: detailed financial loss quantification report with supporting model and expert testimony-ready analysis.

hire_title: Quantify Synergies for Logistics Carve-Out Acquisition
hire_description: A Singapore-based logistics group is acquiring a carve-out business and needs someone to identify and quantify revenue and cost synergies across one business function. The specialist must assess separation dependencies, develop a business case with one-time and ongoing savings, incremental costs, and a high-level roadmap. Deliverable: detailed synergy analysis report with quantified savings, cost impact, and implementation timeline for one function.

hire_title: Assess Value-Based Care Contract Performance and Identify Revenue Gaps
hire_description: A Singapore-based academic healthcare system is facing rising care costs and missed quality targets while managing value-based contracts. It needs someone to analyze multiyear contract performance, identify revenue leakage and quality shortfalls, and assess how staffing and workflows affect financial outcomes. The specialist will review actuarial and financial data, pinpoint root causes of underperformance, and map gaps in care management execution. Deliverable: report with findings on revenue gaps, quality shortfalls, and actionable recommendations to improve contract performance without increasing staff.

hire_title: Prepare Restructuring Opinion for Fresh Capital Injection
hire_description: Our Tier 1 automotive supplier in Singapore is preparing to secure S$75 million in fresh capital from lenders to stabilise liquidity following the cancellation of OEM call-off contracts. Lenders require an independent expert restructuring opinion as a precondition for the debt equity swap and bridge financing. We need a specialist to assess our current financial controls and operational stability to validate our ability to repay. This involves reviewing recent financial data and demonstrating improved financial transparency to support the case for robust resourcing. Deliverable: a formal restructuring opinion document ready for lender submission.

hire_title: Optimize Vendor Contracts Post-Merger
hire_description: A Singapore-based technology company formed from the merger of two businesses needs to streamline its vendor contract portfolio. The specialist will work with finance and procurement to understand supplier performance and market dynamics, then produce a clear summary for each vendor. Deliverable: a set of vendor ‘baseball cards’ with contract terms, spend analysis, and recommended actions (terminate, consolidate, renegotiate, or extend).

hire_title: Map Product Migration Paths for HR Tech Clients
hire_description: A Singapore-based HR technology company is phasing out legacy products to improve its cost structure and needs to migrate customers to its core offerings. The specialist must also size the necessary sales and solution consultant capacity to execute these migrations efficiently without requiring significant new investment. Deliverable: written gap analysis, prioritised migration path definitions, and a capacity model.

hire_title: Develop Churn Mitigation Analysis and Predictive Model
hire_description: I lead the commercial team at a Singapore-based financial services manufacturing company with over S$4 billion in revenue. hire_title: AI Proof of Concept for RFP-to-Cash Automation

hire_description: A Singapore-based addiction treatment provider wants to improve the speed and efficiency of its patient intake process. hire_description: A Singapore-based consumer services company with over S$4 billion in annual revenue needs to restructure its digital operations to improve ROI. hire_description: We are a Singapore-based telecom group preparing to spin off a key business unit. hire_title: Automated Accounts Payable Process Review for Healthcare

hire_title: Review Claims Processing Controls for Third-Party Partner
hire_description: A Singapore-based commercial property and casualty insurer is expanding operations and needs to strengthen its internal audit function. This includes reviewing workflows, data handling, and reconciliation processes. Deliverable: written assessment report with findings and recommendations.

Deliverable: a prioritised list of automation opportunities with estimated value realisation.

hire_description: A Singapore-based multifamily property management company processes over 70,000 invoices monthly across hundreds of properties. hire_description: A Singapore-based electronics components distributor is finalising the ERP strategy for its most recent acquisition. hire_description: We’re a Singapore-based asset management firm with outdated financial systems. hire_description: A Singapore-based gasoline retailer is seeking to improve its audit approach and operational insights by analyzing how weather affects sales at individual retail locations. hire_description: Our finance team supports a quarterly financial statement audit, but manually extracting and normalising general ledger data takes about 24 hours each quarter. Deliverable: working automated data ingestion and normalisation script.

hire_title: Cloud Migration Roadmap for Core Banking Platform
hire_description: A Singapore-based regional bank needs to modernise its core banking platform to support growth. The in-house system is outdated, with inconsistent updates and poor scalability. hire_title: Map Municipal Payment Processing Opportunities for Bank
hire_description: I run the business development team at a Singapore-based commercial bank and need help identifying new municipal payment processing opportunities. Deliverable: detailed opportunity matrix with 5-7 prioritised expansion targets, including revenue estimates and bid process recommendations.

We’ll meet weekly with the specialist to review insights and apply them to tax savings and strategic decisions. hire_title: Assess Financial Processes for Workday Implementation
hire_description: A Singapore-based premium financing firm is preparing to replace its legacy general ledger with Workday Core Financials. This assessment will guide the subsequent system design and data conversion strategy. Deliverable: a process gap analysis report highlighting specific areas for automation and integration improvements.

hire_description: A Singapore-based global bank with over 1,000 AI initiatives has evolved its AI systems toward autonomous agents that make real-time decisions and invoke tools. hire_title: Validate Go-To-Market Messaging for Energy Platform

hire_title: Document Manual Tax Processes for Knowledge Transfer

hire_title: Review and Strengthen Internal Audit of Third-Party Partner
hire_description: A Singapore-based commercial property and casualty insurer is expanding operations and needs to improve its internal audit function. hire_title: Review Sales and Marketing Alignment for Medical Device Maker
