We are a Singapore-based tech firm resolving a data breach affecting 200 million accounts. We need a specialist to design the notice media strategy for the class action settlement. The scope covers planning a targeted notice programme across print, press releases, and online channels, aiming for over 320 million impressions. You must ensure the campaign includes fraud mitigation measures to protect our brand from ad fraud and mis-targeting. The plan must support a multi-lingual audience (English, Spanish, Russian, Hebrew, Arabic) to reach the international class members effectively.
Deliverable: detailed notice media plan with channel mix, budget allocation, and fraud mitigation protocols.

hire_title: Government Settlement Notice and Eligibility Review
hire_description:
A Singapore-based financial institution is managing a regulatory enforcement action requiring the administration of customer compensation. We need a specialist to design and execute the notice and eligibility workflow for one specific customer cohort (e.g., opt-in or self-identified customers). This involves creating eligibility forms, translating key documents into major languages (Mandarin, Malay, etc.), and conducting address tracing to resolve undeliverable mail. The specialist must also set up a secure method for customers to submit forms digitally.
Deliverable: validated eligibility data report and completed form submission for the assigned cohort.

hire_title: Digital Forensics Investigation of Ransom Email and Suspected Insider Threat
hire_description: A Singapore-based global software company received a ransom email claiming access to sensitive data, including PII, financial records, and source code. The email demanded one million euros in bitcoin. We need someone to investigate the ransom note, trace the sender’s digital footprint, and determine if the threat is external or an insider. The specialist must use digital forensics tools to analyze the email and any linked accounts, and check for data exfiltration via dark web monitoring. Deliverable: forensic analysis report with findings on the origin of the threat, suspect identification, and evidence of data exposure.

hire_title: Penetration Test for Election Audit Software Platform
hire_description: I run the security assurance team at a Singapore-based non-profit organisation developing open-source election audit software. We’re preparing to deploy our flagship tool, Arlo, for post-election audits and need a specialist to perform a penetration test before rollout. The test must cover both the web application and the supporting infrastructure, including production and staging environments. We need a thorough assessment of the software’s security logic and implementation, plus a source code review to identify any vulnerabilities. Deliverable: comprehensive penetration test report with findings, risk ratings, and remediation recommendations.

hire_title: Automate Third-Party Onboarding with Risk-Based Questionnaires
hire_description: An oilfield service company in Singapore needs to replace its paper-based third-party onboarding process with an automated system. We’re looking for someone to design and set up a digital workflow using a compliance portal, including custom onboarding questionnaires that assign initial risk scores based on anti-bribery and corruption policies. The specialist will configure the system to collect business details, geographical locations, beneficial owners, and document uploads, then route risk scores and approvals to legal, compliance and finance teams. Deliverable: configured digital workflow with custom questionnaires and risk scoring logic in the compliance portal.

hire_title: Migrate SIEM and Endpoint Tools to CrowdStrike in Singapore
hire_description: A Singapore-based manufacturer has reduced its cybersecurity team to two full-time employees and needs to cut escalating SIEM and legacy endpoint costs. The hirer requires a specialist to replace fragmented legacy tools with the CrowdStrike Falcon platform, including Next Gen SIEM, and migrate security data to optimize ingestion and retention. This involves consolidating endpoint protection and SIEM onto a single platform to improve visibility without increasing risk. Deliverable: written migration plan and technical design for the CrowdStrike deployment and data migration.

hire_title: Manage Breach Notification for Insurance Client
hire_description: We are a Singapore-based insurance and asset management firm. We require specialist support to handle breach notification for a large-scale data security incident impacting approximately 4 million customer and employee records. The scope covers executing expedited mailing and call center support for around 3.5 million affected individuals, managing over 57,000 calls, and coordinating a data reconciliation between notification lists and breached data to verify completeness. Deliverable: completed notification execution and a full reconciliation report of all affected individuals.

hire_title: Automate Data Extraction from 15,000 Legacy Contracts Using Relativity
hire_description: A Singapore-based global travel services company needs to centralize over 15,000 legacy contracts into a contract lifecycle management system. Many contracts are scanned documents, and 20 specific data points (including termination, renewal, and governing law clauses) must be extracted accurately. We need someone to build and deploy AI-powered Relativity contract analytics with custom GenAI prompts to automate extraction, then validate results with targeted quality checks. Deliverable: automated data extraction pipeline with validated output for 15,000 contracts.

hire_title: AI Prompt Testing for 80k Document Legal Review
hire_description:
A Singapore-based consumer products company is facing a commercial dispute and needs to efficiently review a dataset of 80,000 documents. The client aims to use Relativity aiR for Review to automate the first-pass document analysis, reducing manual workload by over 90%. The specialist must develop initial prompts using matter materials, such as the Statement of Claim, and run live workshops to refine these prompts based on client-provided terms and context. The core task involves validating the AI's performance using statistically valid samples to achieve a 99% confidence level with a ±5% margin of error, ensuring 94%+ recall before final deployment.

Deliverable: validated AI prompt set with a performance validation report confirming recall and precision metrics.

hire_title: Penetration Testing for AWS Cloud Infrastructure
hire_description: We are a Singapore-based specialist bank with a recently launched online banking portal and an increasing volume of workloads on Amazon Web Services. We need a penetration test focused specifically on our AWS environment to identify vulnerabilities that previous external scans missed. The scope covers configuration testing, web application testing, and a review of firewall rules to assess the risk of unauthorised access to critical systems. Testing must be conducted remotely to avoid disrupting business operations. Deliverable: A detailed technical report listing identified vulnerabilities, the ease of exploitation for each, and actionable remediation advice.

hire_title: Assess Cyber Risks During Azure Migration for Shipping Company
hire_description: We are a Singapore-based shipping company migrating to Microsoft Azure to centralise IT across our offices and maritime centres. As part of this shift, we need to strengthen our cyber defences. We’re looking for someone to conduct a vulnerability scan and CREST-accredited penetration test on our current systems, focusing on gaps before the migration. This includes evaluating our legacy SIEM and preparing for cloud-native monitoring with Microsoft Sentinel. Deliverable: detailed vulnerability assessment report with remediation recommendations.

hire_title: Investigate Business Email Compromise Attack on Office 365 Account
hire_description: A Singapore-based independent insurance broker, handling sensitive client data for high-value mergers and acquisitions, detected a business email compromise (BEC) attack targeting a client with nearly S$500K in fraudulent invoices. The attack used a compromised senior employee’s Office 365 account to spoof communications. We need someone to investigate the source and scope of the breach by analysing Office 365 email logs and audit trails, identifying how the attacker accessed the account, what rules or forwarding mechanisms were deployed, and tracing malicious login attempts from external IPs. Deliverable: formal incident report with full timeline, attack vector analysis, and recommendations to prevent future breaches.

hire_title: OT Security Architecture Review for Pipeline
hire_description: Review our operational technology (OT) security architecture against ISA/IEC 62443 standards. The scope covers asset and network architecture analysis, validation of segmentation and access paths, and a review of policies. We need actionable gaps identified to strengthen micro-segmentation and access control across our OT environment without disrupting operations. Deliverable: written gap analysis and prioritised remediation roadmap.

hire_title: Incident Response for Trickbot Malware Infection
hire_description: I run the IT security function at a private healthcare organisation in Singapore that handles large volumes of sensitive patient data. We were recently infected with Trickbot malware, which was spreading via employee roaming profiles and attempting to exfiltrate data. I need someone to investigate the incident, contain the infection, and identify how it entered our network. The specialist must use an Endpoint Detection and Response (EDR) tool to detect and isolate infected hosts, analyse the kill chain, and determine if any credentials were compromised. Deliverable: detailed incident report with timeline, containment actions, and recommendations to prevent future attacks.

hire_title: Manage global breach notification for financial firm
hire_description: I manage risk at a Singapore-based financial and insurance services firm following a critical ransomware attack that exposed 6.5 million customers’ data. We need a specialist to design and execute a compliant breach notification strategy across our multiple client entities, each with unique regulatory timelines and requirements. The scope includes preparing tailored notice versions (physical and email), coordinating identity and credit monitoring offers, and managing a dedicated call centre to handle individual enquiries. Deliverable: operational notification plan, 150+ notice versions, and final compliance reports.

hire_title: Red team assessment for crypto bank cloud environment
hire_description: A Singapore-based cryptocurrency bank requires a red team assessment to evaluate its security posture following a major cloud migration. The scope focuses on identifying vulnerabilities in access control, key management, and cloud architecture resilience. The specialist must conduct a realistic adversary simulation using threat-driven techniques, including custom development where necessary, to test detection and response capabilities. Deliverable: written red team assessment report with prioritised remediation findings.

hire_title: Investigate Electronic Gift Card Fraud Surge
hire_description: We are a Singapore-based retailer operating a private label credit card scheme. After shifting to e-commerce in March 2020, we noticed a 30-fold spike in electronic gift card purchases, totaling S$1.5 million. We need a PCI forensic investigator to determine if our card data was compromised. The work involves analysing transaction logs, reviewing the authorization process with our card issuer, and checking if expiry and CVV are verified. Deliverable: a report identifying the fraud mechanism and confirming whether a data breach occurred.

hire_title: Integrate Security Tools for Enhanced Cyber Visibility
hire_description: A Singapore-based national housebuilder relies heavily on cloud services to support a large, dispersed mobile workforce. Currently, security logs from key systems are not consistently captured or correlated, leaving critical gaps in threat visibility. The existing setup includes over 1,100 endpoint devices and corporate infrastructure, but lacks unified monitoring. We need a specialist to configure and integrate security telemetry from Microsoft 365, Cisco Meraki, Cisco Umbrella, Cradlepoint NetCloud, Fortinet FortiGate, and SpyCloud into a centralised monitoring environment. This involves ensuring logs are properly parsed and correlated to eliminate blind spots. Deliverable: a fully integrated log ingestion pipeline with verified data flow from all listed sources.

hire_title: Migrate MDR Client to CrowdStrike Falcon Complete
hire_description: We are a Singapore-based managed security service provider serving global clients. We need to migrate one of our MDR clients from a legacy EDR and SIEM environment to CrowdStrike Falcon Complete Next-Gen MDR. The work includes deploying the Falcon agent across all endpoints, configuring NG-SIEM log sources, and operationalizing the new environment. We require standardised migration engineering, including endpoint onboarding, log ingestion, and integration with existing security workflows. Deliverable: fully migrated and operational MDR environment with documentation of configuration and handover notes.

hire_title: DORA Compliance Assessment for Investor Services Firm
hire_description: A Singapore-based investor services firm needs help preparing for DORA compliance. They lack in-house expertise and need a clear view of their readiness against the EU’s Digital Operational Resilience Act, including its regulatory technical standards (RTS). The work involves assessing their operational resilience across five core areas, measuring compliance gaps quantitatively, and aligning with ISO 27001 standards. Deliverable: detailed assessment report with gap analysis and prioritized action list.

hire_title: Draft and Audit Breach Notification Letters for Patient Intake Software
hire_description: A Singapore-based healthcare technology company managing patient intake software must notify 570,000 affected individuals after a third-party data breach. The specialist must draft plain-language, compliant breach notification letters and create a defensible audit trail for the mailing logistics. All communications must meet stringent healthcare data protection regulations and accurately explain the personal impact and protective steps for recipients. Deliverable: finalised set of breach notification letters and a mailing readiness audit report.

hire_title: Endpoint Detection and Response for Legacy Industrial Control Systems
hire_description: I run the IT security team at a Singapore-based plastics manufacturing company with multiple production sites. We’ve expanded rapidly and now rely on legacy industrial control systems that can’t be patched, increasing our cyber risk. We need someone to install and configure endpoint sensors on these key systems, monitor for threats targeting unpatched vulnerabilities, and provide real-time alerts. The specialist must use EDR technology to detect known and unknown threats and integrate with our existing SIEM. Deliverable: fully configured endpoint sensors, threat monitoring setup, and a report on initial threat findings.

hire_title: Ransomware Readiness Assessment for Singapore Shipping Firm
hire_description: Our Singapore-based shipping firm manages about 600 vessels and 135 years of industry history. We have a small IT team but need to significantly improve our ransomware defences given the threat of global disruptions. We require a specialist to conduct a targeted ransomware readiness assessment examining 14 crucial security areas and attack vectors across our hybrid infrastructure and Office 365 environment. The review must evaluate our current visibility, vulnerability management, and incident response capabilities to ensure we meet compliance obligations such as GDPR. Deliverable: written gap analysis and prioritised action list for improving threat detection.

hire_title: Web Application Penetration Test for Singapore Telecom
hire_description: We are a Singapore-based telecommunications operator managing a diverse portfolio of web applications. While we have protected our most critical systems, we need to extend our security shield to a subset of lower-risk applications to safeguard our reputation. We require a specialist to conduct manual penetration testing on approximately 25 internal web applications. The scope includes identifying vulnerabilities that automated scanners miss, testing the effectiveness of our existing Web Application Firewall (WAF) by routing tests through it, and verifying the coverage of our scanning programme. Deliverable: a consolidated report detailing identified vulnerabilities, WAF effectiveness insights, and a comparison of manual versus automated detection rates.

hire_title: Draft Security Services Lifecycle Framework for Regional Bank
hire_description: CISO of a Singapore-based regional bank subsidiary needs a structured framework to gain oversight of centrally managed security services, including monitoring, incident response, and threat intelligence. Currently, there is no formal contract or defined process for managing these services, leading to gaps in governance and regulatory assurance. The task involves assessing existing service documentation and defining a lifecycle framework for onboarding, managing, and governing these services. This includes establishing roles, responsibilities, and escalation paths. Deliverable: a Security Services Lifecycle Framework (SSLF) manual outlining the operating model and governance processes.

hire_title: SWIFT Network Forensic Analysis and Remediation Plan
hire_description:
We are a Singapore-based financial institution seeking an independent specialist to conduct a targeted forensic review of our SWIFT network environment following suspicious transaction activity. We need an expert to analyse logs and system artifacts from a suspected incident window, identify compromised accounts or endpoints, and verify the integrity of our network controls against specific malware vectors like credential capture tools. The scope focuses on isolated analysis and remediation guidance for the SWIFT-related assets only, excluding broader organisational security overhauls.

Deliverable: written forensic investigation report detailing the attack vector, compromised assets, and prioritised remediation actions.

hire_title: Conduct Controlled Phishing Test for Employee Awareness
hire_description: A Singapore-based financial services company has recently enhanced its cyber security posture and is launching an intensive employee awareness and training programme. To validate the effectiveness of this new training, we need a specialist to design and execute a controlled phishing campaign targeting staff members. The goal is to measure click rates and identify vulnerabilities without causing operational disruption. Deliverable: results report with engagement metrics and recommendations for further training.

hire_title: Investigate E-commerce Checkout Skimming Script
hire_description:
I run a high-end meat purveyor in Singapore that shifted fully to online sales during the pandemic. After receiving several customer complaints about unauthorized credit card transactions, I need a PCI forensics investigator to determine if our e-commerce site was compromised. The work involves simulating an online transaction with a test card to trace cardholder data flow, reviewing webserver access logs to identify the initial intrusion point, and analysing any malicious scripts or web shells installed on the server.

Deliverable: A forensic report detailing the data exfiltration method, the timeline of the breach, and the specific vulnerabilities exploited.

hire_title: Assess Cyber Security Alert Overload
hire_description: I lead IT at a Singapore-based specialist asset manager. Our current antivirus and perimeter security tools generate too many alerts, making it hard for the team to distinguish critical threats from noise. We need a consultant to review our existing security monitoring setup and help us filter these alerts effectively. You should assess our current posture and recommend how to improve our ability to detect malicious activity quickly without building a full in-house 24/7 Security Operations Centre. Deliverable: a written assessment of the alert filtering gaps and a prioritised list of recommended monitoring improvements.

hire_title: Deploy CrowdStrike Falcon Endpoint Protection for Singapore Outlets
hire_description: We run a quick-service restaurant chain in Singapore with multiple outlets and a lean IT team. We need to quickly deploy enterprise-grade endpoint protection to all our locations without disrupting daily operations. You’ll lead the end-to-end rollout of CrowdStrike Falcon Endpoint Protection across our Singapore sites, including device onboarding, configuration, and integration with our existing systems. Deliverable: fully deployed and operational CrowdStrike Falcon protection across all Singapore outlets, with documentation of setup and configuration.

hire_title: Reduce False Positives in Security Alerts for Hybrid IT Environment
hire_description: A Singapore-based mid-sized bank with a hybrid IT environment—combining on-premises legacy systems and AWS cloud workloads, including a new online banking portal—needs help reducing the volume of false-positive security alerts. The bank’s small in-house team is overwhelmed by the growing number of alerts, which are slowing down threat response. We require a specialist to analyse and triage alerts generated by our existing security information and event management (SIEM) system, using threat intelligence and kill chain analysis to filter out noise. The goal is to improve detection accuracy and free up internal resources for real incident response. Deliverable: monthly report with alert analysis, prioritised threat list, and actionable mitigation guidance via a secure threat management platform.

hire_title: Draft breach notification letters for relocation firm
hire_description:
A Singapore-based relocation and moving services provider has experienced a third-party data breach affecting over 1 million individuals across multiple jurisdictions. We need to identify the specific regulatory requirements for Singapore (PDPA) and draft a compliant, plain-language notification letter for affected local data owners. The letter must clearly explain the incident, the data involved, and the remediation steps being offered, while maintaining message control to protect the organisation’s reputation. You will segment the notice to meet local legal stipulations and ensure it is ready for distribution via the company’s existing communication channels.
Deliverable: Finalised, compliant breach notification letter text tailored for Singapore residents.

hire_title: Implement Managed Detection and Response for Hospitality Group’s Hybrid IT Environment
hire_description: I run the IT security function at a Singapore-based hospitality group with multiple properties and a hybrid IT environment including legacy on-premises systems and point-of-sale terminals. We recently completed a security audit that showed gaps in our 24/7 threat monitoring and response capability, especially during off-hours. We need someone to implement a managed detection and response (MDR) service to improve our visibility and reduce mean time to detect and respond to threats. The specialist must integrate with our existing infrastructure, provide continuous monitoring, and deliver monthly threat reports. Deliverable: operational MDR service with monthly threat analysis reports and a documented integration plan.

hire_title: Migrate endpoints to CrowdStrike Falcon for real estate firm
hire_description: I manage IT security for a Singapore-based real estate investment firm and our endpoint security licensing lapsed, leaving us with immediate blind spots. I need a specialist to execute a rapid migration to the CrowdStrike Falcon platform, onboard log sources, and configure Fusion SOAR to restore centralized monitoring. Deliverable: fully migrated and monitored CrowdStrike environment with automated incident response enabled.

hire_title: Draft regulatory breach notification letter
hire_description: We are a Singapore-based financial technology company operating payment processing services. Following a recent data exposure incident affecting our clients' users, we need to notify all affected individuals in compliance with Singapore’s PDPA. We require an experienced cyber specialist to review the compromised data scope and draft a clear, plain-language notification letter that explains the incident, outlines the risks, and details the support measures (such as identity monitoring) we are offering. The letter must be legally robust while remaining accessible to the general public. Deliverable: a final, ready-to-send breach notification letter tailored to Singapore regulations.

hire_title: Digital Forensics Analysis for Ransomware Incident
hire_description: Our logistics company suffered a ransomware attack during the rollout of our Endpoint Detection and Response solution. We need a specialist to investigate the events preceding the attack and identify the specific vulnerabilities that allowed the breach to occur. This work is separate from ongoing 24/7 monitoring; we need a focused forensic review to understand how the threat vector exploited our current setup. Deliverable: a written forensic analysis report detailing the attack timeline and specific resilience improvements.

hire_title: Draft Breach Notification Letters for Data Incident
hire_description:
I manage a healthcare administration company in Singapore and suffered a data breach exposing sensitive personal and benefit plan data for roughly 3,340,000 individuals. We need a specialist to draft plain-language, legally compliant notification letters that explain the incident and the support we are offering, such as two years of identity monitoring. The letters must meet strict PDPA requirements and maintain clear message control to minimize business impact.

Deliverable: finalized breach notification letter templates ready for individual and third-party distribution.

hire_title: Kubernetes Security Assessment for Cloud Migrated Workloads
hire_description: A Singapore-based financial institution is migrating business-critical applications to Kubernetes on Google Cloud Platform (GCP) and needs a security assessment to ensure secure-by-default principles. The environment spans multiple clusters, requiring a targeted, intelligence-driven approach that combines automated tooling with manual testing to identify risks without disrupting operations. The goal is to establish a repeatable testing baseline for future workloads. Deliverable: a comprehensive security report highlighting vulnerabilities and a structured model for ongoing validation.

hire_title: Design and Deliver Breach Notification Campaign for Affected Customers
hire_description: A Singapore-based insurance and asset management company was impacted by a third-party data breach affecting around 3 million customers. The company needed to notify affected individuals quickly and securely, with specific requirements for categorizing customer data into multiple subsets for staged mailings. The notification process had to comply with regulatory obligations and provide clear, consistent messaging. Deliverable: a tailored breach notification campaign including 12 staged mailings, with full tracking and reporting for regulatory compliance.

hire_title: Continuous Penetration Testing for Agile Software Development
hire_description: A Singapore-based software startup developing an online proofing platform for marketing teams uses Agile sprints to release new features every two weeks. The company wants to shrink its security risk window by moving from quarterly to more frequent penetration testing, aligned with its development roadmap. It needs a specialist to perform manual penetration tests on new features as they are developed, with testing integrated into each sprint cycle. Deliverable: comprehensive penetration test reports for each feature release, plus a dashboard tracking findings and remediation progress.

hire_title: Forensic Analysis of Fuel Controller Malware
hire_description:
Our regional fuel chain recently faced a spike in fraudulent credit card transactions linked to our gas stations. We need a certified forensic investigator to determine if a breach of cardholder data occurred in our systems, specifically on the fuel controllers. The work involves pulling event logs from all fuel controllers, cross-correlating data to find malicious activity, and reverse-engineering any identified malware in a sandboxed environment to understand its intent and data exfiltration methods. This includes identifying the initial infection vector, which we suspect is a spearphishing campaign targeting HR staff.
Deliverable: a technical report detailing the malware’s capabilities, the specific card data accessed, and the confirmed entry point of the breach.

hire_title: Managed Detection and Response Monitoring for Asset Manager
hire_description: We are a Singapore-based independent asset manager holding prestigious corporate investors. Our small IT team lacks the bandwidth to monitor for threats beyond our perimeter, and we worry hackers could exploit our network as a backdoor to our financial partners' systems. Existing antivirus gives us no visibility if malware penetrates the firewall, and hiring 2-3 internal staff for intrusion detection is cost-prohibitive. We need an external specialist to provide 24/7 proactive network monitoring and incident response. You must integrate proprietary forensic tools with telemetry from our endpoints, network, and cloud/SaaS providers to detect and shut down unauthorised activity rapidly. Deliverable: active 24/7 managed detection and response monitoring service with incident alerts.

hire_title: OT Risk Assessment for Bank Data Centre
hire_description: We are a Singapore-based financial institution managing critical operational technology (OT) infrastructure, including building automation, power distribution, and cooling systems within our data centres. Current visibility into our converged IT/OT environment is limited, and legacy systems create significant security blind spots that traditional IT controls cannot address. We require an independent specialist to conduct a focused OT risk assessment and architecture review aligned with NIST 800-82 standards. This involves mapping asset interdependencies, evaluating existing governance and policy frameworks, and identifying gaps in network segmentation and endpoint protection. The engagement must be non-disruptive to ensure business continuity during our assessment. Deliverable: written OT risk assessment report with architectural review and prioritised remediation actions.

hire_title: Review SIEM Alerts to Reduce False Positives
hire_description:
We are a Singapore-based specialist bank operating a hybrid environment with legacy on-premises infrastructure and AWS workloads, including a new online banking portal. Our current Security Information and Event Management (SIEM) setup generates too many false-positive alarms, straining our small in-house security team and limiting our ability to monitor threats 24/7. We need a specialist to review our alerting logic and triage process to distinguish genuine threats from noise. The goal is to improve the signal-to-noise ratio so our team can focus on incident response rather than investigating invalid alerts, while meeting MAS compliance requirements for financial data protection.
Deliverable: A written assessment of the current alerting configuration with specific recommendations to reduce false positives and optimise triage workflows.

hire_title: Assess and Improve Incident Response Readiness
hire_description: I run the cybersecurity function at a Singapore-based commercial insurance underwriter and administration services company. After our CISO resigned and we cut IT staff, our incident response strategy became outdated and ineffective. I need someone to assess our current incident response plan, review our security policies and procedures, and lead a tabletop exercise with key teams to identify gaps. Deliverable: report with findings, gap analysis, and recommended improvements to our incident response plan.

hire_title: Digital Forensics Investigation of Insider Threat Ransom Attempt
hire_description: Our Singapore-based software company received a ransom demand of S$1.7 million (€1 million) in bitcoin from an anonymous source claiming to hold sensitive data, including source code and bank passwords. We need a forensic specialist to investigate the threat, trace the suspect’s Gmail address, and examine the former employee’s retained company computer at our Singapore office. The analysis must adhere to PDPA standards and identify connections to external devices. Deliverable: well-documented forensic report establishing the insider threat with conclusive evidence suitable for police reporting.

hire_title: Map and Recover Historical Data for Legal Case
hire_description: A Singapore-based law firm is handling a complex litigation case requiring access to historical data from a multinational client. The data spans two decades and is stored in physical archives and legacy systems, with most current staff unaware of past IT infrastructure. We need someone to conduct a structured data mapping exercise, including visiting the client’s storage site in person to locate and log paper documents, identify electronic data sources, contact former employees, and recover data from old servers and laptops. Deliverable: comprehensive data mapping report with documented sources, locations, and recovery methods, along with a list of prioritized data sets for review.

hire_title: Penetration test for open-source election audit software
hire_description: A Singapore-based non-profit vendor specialising in open-source election security software requires an independent security assessment of its platform ahead of critical audit cycles. The system manages risk-limiting audits (RLAs) for government bodies and faces scrutiny regarding data integrity against sophisticated threat actors. We need a specialist to conduct an open-box web application penetration test and a technology-assisted source code review. The scope covers both the production and staging environments to ensure the logic is implemented securely and the underlying infrastructure is robust. Deliverable: written penetration test report with identified vulnerabilities and prioritised remediation steps.

hire_title: Forensic review of branch accounting system reliability
hire_description: We are preparing for litigation regarding the reliability of the accounting system used in our retail branch network. We need a forensic specialist to review system design documents, error logs, audit reports, and software release notes to assess system robustness. The work involves using case management tools to link defect logs and construct a timeline of known bugs and errors that may have caused financial discrepancies. We also need an assessment of remote access controls and policies. Deliverable: a technical expert report detailing system flaws, defect timeline, and remote access control gaps.

hire_title: Expedited KYC and Collateral Agent Appointment
hire_description: We are a Singapore-based renewable energy developer closing a S$470 million financing facility and need a specialist to act as our offshore collateral agent. We face an urgent requirement to complete KYC due diligence and negotiate the international credit agreement to close the transaction quickly. The scope involves reviewing KYC documentation for AML compliance, facilitating rapid contract negotiation, and signing the deal documentation within a single business day. Deliverable: executed collateral agency agreement with cleared KYC on file.

hire_title: Coordinate Rights Offering with DTC ASOP
hire_description: We are a Singapore-based consumer tech company preparing an $80 million (approx. S$110 million) fully backstopped rights offering. We need a specialist to coordinate the setup of this offering with the Depository Trust Company (DTC) in accordance with the Automated Subscription Offer Program (ASOP) guidelines. The role involves customizing our subscription procedures to support basic and over-subscription rights at $11.30 per share, and ensuring precise calculation of new and oversubscribed shares. We also require support in handling shareholder inquiries and maintaining real-time communication with our legal counsel regarding transaction results. Deliverable: successful coordination of the rights offering setup and share allocation calculations.

hire_title: Voluntary Tender Program Administration for Asset Fund
hire_description: We are a Singapore-based asset management firm managing a fund with side-pocketed private securities. Following a regulatory review, we have secured S$400 million to repurchase units from affected investors. We need a specialist to administer a voluntary tender process for one specific fund, handling KYC checks on unitholders, adjudicating submissions against our guidelines, and managing the cash flow for repurchases. Deliverable: fully settled tender program with reconciled payments and cancelled units.

hire_title: Draft Equity Rights Offering Procedures
hire_description:
We are a Singapore-based issuer preparing a complex equity rights offering and need a specialist to draft the offering procedures. The work must ensure the documents meet current procedural standards for both U.S. and European depositories. You will define the mechanics for noticing, processing subscriptions, and distributing new equity and cash, ensuring we can confidently adhere to the required standards while managing thousands of subscription forms and reconciling multiple wire transfers.

Deliverable: comprehensive rights offering procedures document tailored for cross-border depository compliance.

hire_title: Custody Verification via Blockchain Tests for Crypto Exchange
hire_description: Independent verification of digital asset control for a Singapore-based crypto exchange with over 240,000 wallets and 300 token types. The Singapore High Court requires proof of control over private keys as part of an ongoing restructuring. The specialist must coordinate a large-scale custody consolidation effort, executing small, controlled 'Satoshi tests' to demonstrate access to private keys. These tests must be formatted for review by a third-party assessor appointed by the Court. Deliverable: verified custody proof package comprising blockchain transaction logs and test results for court submission.

hire_title: Assess Financial and Operational Synergies for Cruise Line Merger
hire_description: We are a Singapore-based cruise operator planning to merge with another regional operator to expand our market reach and service offerings. We need someone to review the financials and operations of both companies, assess potential synergies, and identify integration risks. This includes analysing revenue streams, cost structures, fleet utilisation, and route overlaps. Deliverable: a concise report with synergy analysis, integration risks, and key recommendations.

hire_title: Assess Local Partner Risks for Joint Venture Entry
hire_description: A Singapore-based consumer goods company is planning to enter a new market via a joint venture with a local partner. We need someone to investigate whether the partner’s management is subject to political influence in commercial decisions, especially in supplier selection. The specialist must review available public and local business information, interview key contacts, and assess potential reputational and operational risks. Deliverable: detailed risk assessment report with findings and recommendations for JV negotiation terms.

hire_title: Benchmarking Manufacturing Capabilities for Singapore Subsidiary
hire_description: A Singapore-based industrial company is reviewing the performance of its local subsidiary and needs an objective assessment of its market position. The specialist must benchmark the site against key local competitors, focusing specifically on production processes, manufacturing capabilities, and the use of alternative raw materials. This involves conducting discrete inquiries among locally based industry experts to obtain informed sources on competitors' capacity and methods. The work requires weighing evidence to provide context beyond public records, ensuring all activities stay within Singapore regulatory boundaries and professional ethics. Deliverable: a detailed dossier on the subsidiary's competitive standing regarding production and raw materials.

hire_title: Execute Drug Recall Notification Campaign
hire_description: We are a Singapore-based pharmaceutical company facing an urgent Class II recall affecting approximately 500,000 customers. We need a specialist to manage the end-to-end notification process, ensuring strict adherence to regulatory timelines and data security standards. The specialist must then coordinate the dispatch of plain-language notification letters and manage any returned mail for audit purposes. Deliverable: completed notification deployment with a final delivery and audit report.

hire_title: Investigate Illicit Trade Routes for Consumer Goods in EU Market
hire_description: I run the trade compliance team at a Singapore-based global consumer goods firm, and we’re losing market share in an EU market due to smuggled products being sold at lower prices without duties. The work includes gathering intelligence through crowdsourcing and analysis, identifying key routes and actors, and verifying information through controlled purchases and source interviews. Deliverable: detailed report with findings on smuggling routes, volume estimates, key actors involved, and recommendations for disrupting the trade.

hire_title: Interim Directorship for Distressed Business Stabilisation
hire_description:
A Singapore-based organisation facing financial distress or operational crisis needs an experienced professional to step in as an interim Director or Chief Restructuring Officer. The specialist will stabilise business operations, restore transparency for stakeholders, and implement enforcement strategies to preserve value while navigating local insolvency requirements. The role involves taking personal directorship responsibility to ensure accountable decision-making, managing stakeholder expectations, and optimizing cash flow performance during the turnaround period.

Deliverable: comprehensive stabilisation plan and interim governance framework.

hire_title: End-of-Fund Life Wind-Down Advisory for Private Capital
hire_description: I manage a private capital fund approaching maturity and need to address the complexities of the end-of-life wind-down phase. My fund is facing rising operational costs and regulatory pressures that make traditional structures difficult to maintain. I need a specialist to design a structural wind-down strategy that extends the runway, reduces ongoing costs, and maximizes investor realizations. The work involves assessing the current portfolio, specifically focusing on distributing approximately S$38 million (USD 25 million) to investors, and implementing plans to minimize value erosion during the transition. Deliverable: written wind-down strategy and prioritized action plan for distribution and cost reduction.

hire_title: Prepare Financial Model for Series B Capital Raise
hire_description:
Our Singapore-based mobile packaging and robotics company is raising a S$52 million Series B round from a growth-stage investor. We need a specialist to build the financial model that will serve as the exclusive advisor’s base for the transaction. The model must reflect our current mix of on-site robotic solutions and national brick-and-mortar variety pack facilities, plus our blockchain-based track-and-trace software platform. It needs to project the impact of the new capital on our supply chain operations and software development costs.

Deliverable: a working financial model in Excel that supports the Series B term sheet negotiation.

hire_title: Financial Due Diligence for Event Rental Business Sale
hire_description: We are selling a special event rental business with over 70 years of history and a combined network of 15 fulfillment centers and 23 showrooms. The review should focus on quality of earnings (QoE) analysis, normalising non-recurring items, and validating the financial position of the operating assets. Deliverable: a formal financial due diligence report including a QoE schedule and working capital analysis.

hire_title: Prepare Financial Due Diligence for M&A Transaction
hire_description: We are a Singapore-based integrated design and engineering firm supplying parts to the automotive and aerospace sectors. We are preparing to sell our thermal management operations in a specific region and need a sell-side advisor to support the process. The specialist must conduct financial due diligence, prepare the information memorandum, and manage the sale of the business unit to a private equity buyer. Deliverable: completed financial due diligence report and information memorandum for the transaction.

hire_title: Simplify TANF intake processes and rules
hire_description: We are a Singapore-based public sector agency delivering Temporary Assistance for Needy Families-style social support programmes. Deliverable: a streamlined process design document with a prioritised list of rule simplifications and operational improvements.

hire_title: Implement rapid-cycle learning for family support programme
hire_description: A Singapore-based statutory board runs a family support and relationship education programme. Recruitment and retention are challenging, and traditional evaluation cycles are too slow to adjust strategies in real time. hire_title: Evaluate Vroom Integration in TANF Coaching Sessions
hire_description: We are a Singapore-based social services agency supporting low-income families through a TANF-like programme. hire_title: Business Process Review for Human Services Ops
hire_description: We are a Singapore-based human services organisation and our administrative workload is drowning out direct client support. We need a specialist to review our core operational processes, focusing specifically on streamlining paperwork and refining program delivery workflows. You will assess current process flows and propose specific improvements for documentation handling and operational routines. Deliverable: a written process improvement plan detailing streamlined paperwork steps and refined program workflows.

hire_title: Gap analysis for Singapore HCBS program expansion
hire_description:
A Singapore-based statutory board responsible for social services is reviewing its Home and Community-Based Services (HCBS) offerings. The current system faces gaps in service access and coordination for older adults and those with disabilities. The specialist needs to conduct a gap analysis identifying existing system strengths and deficiencies, particularly focusing on housing capacity and direct care workforce shortages. The work involves reviewing current program structures against person-centered planning standards to determine where services are duplicated or insufficient.

hire_title: Design Rapid-Cycle Evaluation Toolkit for Educational Software
hire_description: A Singapore-based education technology provider is developing a new learning platform and needs to quickly assess its impact on student outcomes. We need someone to design a low-cost, rapid-cycle evaluation framework using existing data sources and tools, including a web-based, interactive toolkit for school districts to run quick evaluations. Analyse data on risk score decreases, statin/antihypertensive medication usage rates, and all-cause mortality trends relative to a control group to determine if the model's payment incentives for measuring and reducing cardiovascular risks are effective.

hire_title: Review contact tracing interview scripts for equity gaps
hire_description: I lead a Singapore-based public health department. hire_description: A Singapore-based healthcare agency is transitioning Medicaid-enrolled adults from institutional to community settings under court-ordered consent decrees. hire_title: Design Behavioral Intervention for Unemployment Insurance Claimants
hire_description: I run a workforce development programme for a Singapore-based statutory board and need to improve job search compliance among unemployment insurance claimants. hire_title: Evaluate State Apprenticeship System Capacity
hire_description: We are a Singapore-based government agency supporting workforce development and need to assess the capacity of our state apprenticeship system. The work involves analysing published reports and case studies, identifying key indicators of system strength, and summarising findings for policy use. hire_description: Develop a data dashboard using human-centered design principles to visualize and monitor the use of disseminated HIV care resources. hire_description: We are a Singapore-based government agency supporting early childhood development. hire_title: Develop Patient-Reported Outcome Measure for Inpatient Psychiatric Care
hire_description: I run the quality measurement team at a Singapore-based healthcare analytics organisation supporting public health initiatives. hire_title: Mixed-Methods Implementation Assessment for Youth Behavioral Health Program

hire_title: Literature Review on Low-Income Employment Strategies

The review must ensure that patient identification, service type, and date-time stamps are correctly structured for secure, automated submission without manual tabulation.

hire_title: Assess Medicaid Waiver Structure for Community Services

hire_title: Review Home Visiting Program Evidence for Child Maltreatment Outcomes

hire_description: We are a Singapore-based health policy unit supporting government decisions on mental health services. hire_description: We are a Singapore-based non-profit delivering Healthy Marriage and Relationship Education (HMRE) workshops to adults with low incomes. hire_title: Systematic Review of Programs for Low-Income Fathers
