hire_description: I run a faith-based family services organisation in Singapore with a place-based two-generation model. We recently launched a 'Families in Transition' initiative focused on housing support for families fleeing domestic violence. We need to document how this new initiative is being implemented and capture the specific experiences of the families we serve. I need a specialist to design a survey and conduct the evaluation to ensure we understand the service gaps and outcomes. Deliverable: a survey instrument and a brief report documenting the implementation and family experiences.

hire_title: Design Logic Model for Family Support Program
hire_description: A Singapore-based human services organisation running a family support programme for low-income families needs help designing a logic model to clarify how their services lead to intended outcomes. They are preparing for a demonstration project and want to ensure their evaluation framework is clear and measurable. The specialist will work with the programme team to map inputs, activities, outputs, and outcomes, aligning with their goals for family self-sufficiency. Deliverable: completed logic model document with definitions, indicators, and data sources.

hire_title: Literature Synthesis for Family Engagement in Home Visiting
hire_description: A Singapore-based early childhood service provider is seeking to improve participation rates for its home visiting programme. Despite the model's proven benefits for maternal and child health, many eligible families are not recruited or drop out before receiving full services. The client needs a specialist to review existing research to understand why this happens. The scope involves synthesising academic literature and programmatic data to identify factors at the family, visitor, and community levels that influence outreach, recruitment, and retention. The work should specifically address barriers faced by families who are not enrolled or who end participation early. Deliverable: a literature synthesis report outlining evidence-informed strategies to strengthen family engagement.

hire_title: Design Discrete Choice Experiment for Benefit Recipients
hire_description: A Singapore-based research consultancy needs to design a discrete choice experiment to understand how means-tested benefit recipients weigh job opportunities against potential benefit loss. The specialist must create five survey vignettes describing fictional recipients deciding whether to take a higher-paying job. These vignettes should vary systematically across three dimensions: the ease of resuming benefits after loss, the magnitude of monthly earnings increase versus benefit reduction, and the level of job instability or risk of job loss. The design must support analysis within a Bayesian framework to maximize statistical power. Deliverable: a complete survey instrument containing the five varied vignettes and the associated experimental design matrix.

hire_title: Design Peer-to-Peer Learning Curriculum for ACO REACH
hire_description:
I lead quality improvement initiatives for a Singapore-based health cluster and need support with our ACO REACH participation. We are moving from fee-for-service to value-based payment, and our clinicians need to share practical strategies to reduce costs while improving patient experience. I need you to apply adult learning theory to design a structure for our peer-to-peer learning communities. This involves planning virtual webinars, affinity groups, and action groups that allow our providers to exchange best practices. The curriculum must be grounded in data analyses to ensure it addresses real operational gaps.

Deliverable: A structured curriculum plan for the ACO REACH learning community, including webinar topics and affinity group frameworks.

hire_title: Design Foundational Analytic Plan for Youth Homelessness Intervention Evaluation
hire_description: A Singapore-based child welfare agency is designing a new service model to prevent homelessness among transition-age youth with child welfare involvement. They need someone to develop the foundational analytic plan for evaluating the impact of their 'Pathways to Success' intervention. This includes defining evaluation goals, identifying key outcomes, selecting appropriate data sources, and outlining data analysis methods to measure program effectiveness. Deliverable: written foundational analytic plan for the summative evaluation.

hire_title: Patient Perspective Assessment for Primary Care Practice
hire_description: A Singapore-based primary care practice is participating in a comprehensive care model and needs to understand how its high-risk patients perceive care management services. The work involves conducting 1-hour phone interviews with 40 patients, transcribing the conversations verbatim, and analysing the data using a thematic approach to identify perceptions of goal setting, behavioural health support, and barriers to engagement. Deliverable: a written report summarising patient experiences and key themes.

hire_title: Assess Teacher Quality and Classroom Practices in Partner Child Care Centers
hire_description: A Singapore-based early childhood education provider partnering with a government-funded early intervention programme needs to evaluate the quality of its classroom practices and teacher qualifications. The provider runs multiple child care centers with infants and toddlers, and wants to understand how well current staff meet programme standards. The specialist must review teacher credentials (e.g., associate’s degree, CDA, teaching license), assess curriculum use (e.g., Creative Curriculum), and evaluate child assessment tools (e.g., ASQ, Teaching Strategies Gold). They must also examine child-to-adult ratios and group sizes against local early childhood standards. Deliverable: report summarizing teacher qualifications, curriculum and assessment practices, and compliance with quality standards.

hire_title: Data Use Capacity Assessment for School District
hire_description: Our school district has invested in new data systems to link data from multiple sources, but staff outside our central analytics team struggle to know what questions to ask or how to interpret findings. We need an independent specialist to assess our current data use capacity. This involves reviewing our existing data infrastructure, interviewing agency staff to understand current workflows, and identifying gaps in technical skills and analytical capability. We want to understand why single-initiative analyses are not translating into agency-wide policy changes. Deliverable: a written capacity assessment report with specific recommendations for increasing analytic capacity through training or targeted hiring.

hire_title: Data Use Profile for Singapore Education Agency
hire_description: I work in policy evaluation for a Singapore-based statutory board and need to document how our data systems support strategic decision-making. We require a specialist to conduct a structured review of our current data infrastructure, including data systems, staff capabilities, and internal partnerships. The specialist should analyse our recent reporting efforts for the current academic year and identify any gaps or challenges in using data to improve outcomes. Deliverable: a concise organizational profile summarising our data use context, specific project analyses, and lessons learned.

hire_title: Assess Family Engagement Practices for Home Visiting Program
hire_description: We run a home visiting program in Singapore that supports early childhood development and want to improve how we reach, recruit, and retain families. We need someone to review our current outreach and engagement strategies, use the Family Engagement Toolkit resources to assess our strengths and gaps, and help us identify specific actions to improve participation. This includes reviewing our recruitment materials, staff training, and community partnerships. Deliverable: completed self-assessment and action plan using the toolkit’s framework.

hire_title: Staff Retention Strategy Review for Human Services Programme
hire_description: We operate a human services employment programme and are facing high staff turnover due to burnout and low salaries. We need a specialist to review our current hiring and retention practices, specifically focusing on how we support staff through workplace community, celebrations, and growth opportunities. The review should assess whether our current approaches align with best practices for maintaining a motivated talent pool in a high-stress environment. Deliverable: a written report outlining gaps in our retention strategy and specific recommendations for improving staff support and engagement.

hire_title: Design integrated HMRE and financial literacy curriculum for couples
hire_description:
A Singapore-based community welfare agency runs a programme for low-income couples and needs to integrate healthy marriage and relationship education (HMRE) with economic stability services. We want to move beyond separate silos and weave financial literacy directly into our core group workshops, similar to an eight-session model that couples the skills-based relationship curriculum with budgeting, credit, and debt management topics. The specialist must design this integrated content module so it is practical for facilitators and accessible to participants with varying financial baselines.

Deliverable: A structured curriculum outline and session content draft for the eight-session integrated workshop.

hire_title: Rapid Cycle Evaluation of TANF Engagement Interventions
hire_description:
Apply the Learn, Innovate, Improve framework to assess low engagement in a Singapore-based social service agency's TANF program. Specifically, test a revamped eligibility interview process that incorporates a parenting empowerment tool and an overview video. Compare the full intervention against a business-as-usual approach and a lighter version to measure changes in orientation attendance rates within 30 days.
Deliverable: Brief reporting on the effectiveness of the interventions in increasing upfront engagement.

hire_title: Design Outreach Strategy to Boost Attendance for Welfare Program Orientation
hire_description: A Singapore-based social services agency running a welfare-to-work programme for low-income families is seeing low attendance at orientation and initial case manager meetings. They need someone to design and test a proactive outreach strategy to improve attendance, using behavioural insights and rapid-cycle evaluation. The specialist will develop outreach materials, define messaging and timing, and set up a random assignment test over 5-6 weeks. Deliverable: a tested outreach plan with attendance impact data and recommendations for scaling.

hire_title: Apply Behavioral Science to Welfare Interview Process
hire_description: We are a Singapore-based local government body delivering public social assistance benefits and face persistent challenges with clients failing to follow through on referrals from eligibility interviews to employment service providers. We need a specialist to redesign the eligibility interview process using insights from behavioral science. The work involves mapping current friction points, applying the 'Learn, Innovate, Improve' framework to create evidence-driven modifications, and developing a structured engagement strategy to improve client adherence to referrals. Deliverable: a written gap analysis and prioritised action list for the interview redesign.

hire_title: Design youth enrichment grant evaluation for family services
hire_description: I run a human services programme in Singapore supporting families with working parents. We are piloting a 'no strings attached' grant initiative for parents of youth aged 12 to 18 to boost family engagement and stability. I need a specialist to design a lean evaluation framework using surveys and short interviews. The scope focuses on capturing parent experiences around empowerment, social connectedness, and family bonding, plus coach perspectives. Deliverable: a structured brief documenting key themes and parent feedback.

hire_title: Assess Gaps in Veteran Employment Service Delivery
hire_description: We are a Singapore-based statutory board administering a national programme that provides employment services to veterans experiencing homelessness. Current service models rely on isolated case management, and we need to understand where coordination breaks down with other public workforce development partners and the broader homeless response system. The specialist needs to conduct interviews with eight programme grantees and their partners, and administer a survey to the latest cohort of grantees to identify specific gaps in eligibility expansion and skills-based matching. Deliverable: a brief outlining key opportunities for improving coordination and service integration.

hire_title: Analyze Service Receipt Data for Homeless Veterans
hire_description: Our workforce agency needs to understand how veterans experiencing homelessness who co-enroll in our reintegration programme differ from other veterans using our services. Please review the Workforce Integrated Performance System (WIPS) data for programme years 2019 and 2020 to compare service receipt, including individualized career services and Disabled Veteran Outreach Program support. We also need to see if enrollment duration and service intensity vary by characteristics like disability, justice system history, or education level. Deliverable: a data brief describing service types received and comparisons by demographic group.

hire_title: Synthesize Literature on Family Engagement in Home Visiting
hire_description: A Singapore-based early childhood support programme is developing resources to improve family engagement in home visiting services. It needs someone to review and synthesise existing research on factors that facilitate or hinder family participation, including outreach, recruitment, retention, and active involvement. The specialist must identify key facilitators such as relevant content, positive visitor-family dynamics, and flexible scheduling, and summarise evidence-based strategies to support engagement. Deliverable: a concise literature synthesis report summarising key findings and actionable strategies.

hire_title: Design Text Message Campaign to Boost Youth Service Engagement
hire_description: A Singapore-based employment support agency is running a youth job readiness programme and finds that only 30% of participants complete any service within the first 60 days. They want to test whether sending weekly text messages based on behavioural science principles can improve engagement. The specialist will design and draft a 12-week text message campaign, including message content, timing, and behavioural triggers, tailored to young adults in the programme. Deliverable: draft campaign plan with 12 weekly messages and rationale for each.

hire_title: Develop Family Engagement Practices for Home Visiting
hire_description: A Singapore-based home visiting programme is looking to strengthen family participation across outreach, recruitment, and retention. The team needs a specialist to outline evidence-informed practices for seven key factors that promote engagement at each stage of interaction. This involves reviewing current program materials and aligning them with established engagement strategies. Deliverable: a concise brief detailing practices for the seven factors with specific examples for program staff.

hire_title: Bayesian Analysis of Program Impact for Small Sample Data
hire_description: A Singapore-based government agency is evaluating a pilot social service program with limited participants and mixed outcomes. They need a statistician to apply Bayesian methods to interpret whether the program produced meaningful benefits, given the small sample size and uncertainty. The specialist will use prior evidence and new data to estimate the probability of positive impact and assess whether the evidence supports scaling or further study. Deliverable: written analysis with probability estimates and policy recommendations.

hire_title: Evaluate Remote Learning Strategy Using e2i Coach Platform
hire_description: I run a school district in Singapore and need to test which remote learning approaches work best for our students. We’re using the e2i Coach platform to design an evaluation that matches our context and goals. I need someone to set up the evaluation, define the treatment and comparison groups using our student data, run the analysis through the platform, and compile the results into a clear report. Deliverable: a succinct evaluation report with findings on which remote learning strategies are most effective.

hire_title: Build Real-Time Monitoring System for Health Program
hire_description: A Singapore-based public health agency is managing a large-scale community health programme and needs to improve its ability to track performance and respond quickly to emerging issues. The agency requires someone to design and set up a real-time monitoring system that pulls data from multiple sources, including clinic records and patient feedback, and displays key indicators in a dashboard. The system must support daily oversight and allow programme managers to identify trends and take action within 24 hours. Deliverable: functional real-time monitoring dashboard with data integration and alerting features.

hire_title: Evidence Gap Map for Urban Waste Policy
hire_description: A Singapore-based statutory board managing urban services is reviewing its research agenda to better address the link between waste infrastructure, child health, and women’s empowerment. We need a specialist to conduct a consultation and evidence-gap mapping exercise. This involves reviewing existing policy documents and academic literature to identify where current data fails to capture the specific impacts of waste management on these demographic groups. The goal is to ensure our upcoming research questions are rooted in local realities rather than generic service delivery metrics. Deliverable: a structured evidence and gap map document outlining key knowledge voids and suggested research priorities.

hire_title: Develop mentorship framework for early career researchers
hire_description: We manage a S$13 million poverty research programme and are moving beyond simple grant funding to build a stronger research ecosystem. We need a specialist to design a formalised mentorship programme for our early career researchers in a single pilot country. This involves defining the pairing criteria between junior researchers and senior experts, outlining the support structure, and identifying relevant external training opportunities like small area estimation workshops. Deliverable: a written mentorship framework document with pairing guidelines and a list of identified external training partners.

hire_title: Assess Drought Insurance Payout Distribution in African Country
hire_description: We are a Singapore-based government agency supporting climate resilience in developing countries. We need someone to review how a specific African country uses sovereign drought insurance payouts to support vulnerable households. The work involves analysing ARC insurance payout data, reviewing government distribution processes, and identifying delays or targeting gaps. We want to understand why aid often takes longer than four months to reach recipients, despite the mandate for swift delivery. Deliverable: report with findings on payout-to-aid conversion delays and recommendations for improving distribution efficiency.

hire_title: Forestry Transparency Database Review and Access Strategy
hire_description: A Singapore-based statutory board managing natural resources needs to improve data accessibility for forest sector governance. The task is to review existing IT systems and licensing information portals to identify gaps in transparency and user access. This involves mapping current database structures, assessing the usability of public-facing timber directories, and recommending a clear plan for an open-access information framework that supports independent monitoring. Deliverable: short technical assessment and prioritised roadmap for improving data openness.

hire_title: Map Adaptation Investment Opportunities in India
hire_description: I work for a Singapore-based international development consultancy and need someone to map viable private investment opportunities in climate adaptation for a specific region. We’re focusing on India, where we’ve identified 77 potential markets across infrastructure, manufacturing, resources and services. I need you to review the existing market scan, assess the risk and potential for ten sample adaptation solutions, and identify key market barriers. This includes regulatory, financial, information and technology constraints. Deliverable: report summarising the 10 solutions with risk assessment and market barrier analysis.

hire_title: Climate Health Vulnerability Assessment for Provincial Health Department
hire_description: We are a Singapore-based provincial health department facing rising climate risks, including heatwaves and floods. We need a specialist to conduct a Climate Health Vulnerability Assessment (CHVA). The work involves analysing current system capacities, mapping projected future risks for vector-borne and water-borne diseases, and identifying gaps in infrastructure and staffing. We must understand how climate events like floods affect service delivery and vulnerable populations. Deliverable: a written assessment report detailing vulnerabilities, system capacities, and recommended adaptation strategies.

hire_title: Develop Stata power calculation command for complex evaluations
hire_description: I work in research and evidence and need a specialist to build a new power calculation command for Stata. Existing tools typically only calculate sample size, leaving a gap for projects requiring simultaneous estimation of minimum detectable effect and power. The new command must support proportions and means, and account for complex design parameters including difference-in-differences, regression discontinuity, clustering, inter-temporal correlation, variance, and finite population corrections. This will streamline our quantitative impact evaluations. Deliverable: a complete, documented Stata command file and user guidelines for the beta version.

hire_title: Review Employment Outcomes for Female Trainees in Skills Programme
hire_description: A Singapore-based vocational training provider is running a skills programme for young women, targeting employment in retail and IT-enabled services. They need someone to review employment outcomes for female trainees over the last 12 months, focusing on job placement and three-month retention rates. The specialist must analyse programme data, compare results across cohorts, and identify factors affecting retention. Deliverable: report with findings on placement and retention rates, key barriers, and recommendations for improvement.

hire_title: Participatory Theory of Change Design for Vocational Programme
hire_description: We are a Singapore-based non-profit running a vocational training initiative for young women entering the local job market. We need to move beyond standard planning and build a Theory of Change that reflects the actual needs of our stakeholders. The work involves facilitating participatory sessions to align the distinct goals of our funder (economic empowerment), local employers (soft-skilled hires), and the target participants (decent, enjoyable jobs). We need to synthesise these inputs into a credible framework that ensures shared ownership of the programme objectives. Deliverable: a validated Theory of Change document outlining the aligned objectives and implementation roadmap.

hire_title: Local Engagement Review for Research Programme
hire_description: We run a development research fund in Singapore focused on urban policy and need to verify that local stakeholders genuinely drive the agenda. Currently, our call for proposals is designed centrally, but we suspect this limits relevance. I need you to review our process and run a one-off engagement workshop with government and academic partners to identify their true research priorities. This involves mapping the gap between our current proposal and local needs, and advising on how to structure a National Steering Committee so they shape the selection criteria and scoring, rather than just rubber-stamping. Deliverable: a short report detailing the engagement findings and a practical guide for setting up the steering committee.

hire_title: Review Play-to-Learn Programme Implementation Fidelity
hire_description: I run a child development programme in a refugee setting in Singapore and we’re using a blended model of weekly IVR messages and monthly home visits by trained facilitators. We need someone to review how well the facilitators are delivering the Play-to-Learn activities, especially whether they’re prioritising interactive play over health messages. The specialist must assess facilitator practices and caregiver engagement based on field observations and programme records. Deliverable: written report identifying gaps in implementation and recommendations for improving fidelity.

hire_title: Assess Protection Programme Adaptability Amid Policy Shifts in Pakistan
hire_description: We are evaluating a refugee protection programme in Pakistan to understand how well it adapts to rapid policy changes, particularly the blanket returns policy. The work involves reviewing programme documentation, analysing quantitative feedback from beneficiaries, and conducting key informant interviews to assess whether the programme’s design assumptions still hold. Deliverable: report summarising findings on programme adaptability and protection effectiveness.

hire_title: Design gender-responsive MEL framework for youth skills programme
hire_description: I manage a skills and employment programme in Singapore targeting 500 youth and women. Current placement data shows low three-month retention, especially for women, and our partners are skeptical of our monitoring methods. I need a specialist to design a trainee-centric evaluation framework that uses plain-language surveys and telephone interviews to track certification, placement, and retention. The work must include translating tools for clarity and ensuring data protection protocols so our stakeholders trust the evidence. Deliverable: complete evaluation methodology document, including survey instruments, translation guide, and trust-building engagement plan.

hire_title: Assess Insecurity Impact on Learning Access in Northern Nigeria
hire_description: A development organisation needs to generate robust evidence on how insecurity affects access, equity, and quality of learning in crisis-affected areas. The specialist will conduct a study to identify gaps in education provision and evaluate current resilience measures. Deliverable: written study report with actionable recommendations for government and donors to protect education.

hire_title: Independent Evaluation for Hydropower Rehabilitation Project
hire_description: A Singapore-based independent development consultancy needs an impact evaluation for a major hydropower rehabilitation project. The work involves assessing the effectiveness of grant activities across four sub-components, focusing on how these interventions supported local hydropower infrastructure and community development initiatives. The specialist will analyse project data to determine outcomes and value for money. Deliverable: written impact assessment report.

hire_title: Fiscal Affordability Study for Primary Education Programme
hire_description:
I manage the budgeting team for a primary education quality improvement programme in Singapore. We have implemented a school improvement approach in several districts and need to assess the feasibility of rolling this out across the rest of the country. I need a specialist to analyse the overall and component-specific costs of the current programme to determine if national scale-up is financially viable. This includes reviewing expenditure data and cost structures to understand what extending the programme would require.
Deliverable: A fiscal affordability study reporting the overall and component costs, with an assessment of financial feasibility for expansion.

hire_title: Verify Training Completion and Retention Data for Skill Development Programme
hire_description: A Singapore-based skills development initiative, supported by a results-based finance model, needs to validate training completion and three-month job retention data for a cohort of trainees. The work involves checking data from the Skill India Portal for errors or inconsistencies, then conducting independent sample verification through interviews with beneficiaries and employers to ensure accuracy. Data will be triangulated to confirm outcomes. Deliverable: verified dataset with summary report of discrepancies and validation findings.

hire_title: Assess Vaccine Cold Chain Temperature Monitoring at Service Delivery Sites
hire_description: We manage immunisation services across multiple districts in Singapore and need to assess cold chain temperature monitoring practices at selected service delivery sites. The assessment must follow WHO/UNICEF guidelines, covering temperature stability within the +2°C to +8°C range, and identify risks such as heat exposure and freezing during transport and storage. Field data will be collected using standardised digital tools, with real-time quality assurance. Deliverable: report with findings on temperature excursions, root causes, and recommendations for improvement.

hire_title: Develop HIV Sustainability Roadmap for National Response
hire_description: A Singapore-based public health organisation requires support to draft a sustainability roadmap for its national HIV response. The aim is to navigate the path towards long-term sustainability in the context of reduced external resources and economic downturns. The specialist needs to analyse current programme dependencies on external funding and identify transformative actions to ensure the HIV response remains effective and efficient. This work supports the broader goal of ending AIDS as a public health threat by 2030 and aligning with Global Fund programme requirements for sustainability. Deliverable: a draft HIV Sustainability Roadmap document outlining the path towards sustainability.

hire_title: Design climate-health and NCD training module for VHWs
hire_description:
We are a Singapore-based public health consultancy supporting a national Ministry of Health to upskill village health workers (VHWs) in NCD detection and climate resilience. Current training is fragmented and lacks clear national guidelines for coordinating climate emergencies or identifying climate-sensitive NCDs. We need a specialist to synthesise evidence, conduct a situational analysis of training gaps, and design a tailored training module that integrates these skills without over-medicalising the VHW role or adding to their workload. The work includes qualitative interviews and a stakeholder workshop to ensure local ownership and GEDSI compliance.

Deliverable: a practical, locally owned training module on climate-health and NCDs, validated through stakeholder consultation.

hire_title: Develop National Disaster Risk Financing Strategy
hire_description: A Singapore-based government ministry of finance is seeking to diversify its sources of disaster risk financing. The team needs support to draft a national strategy that identifies and secures ex-ante financing through the budget, reducing the opportunity costs of sectors hit by emergency budget cuts. The specialist must also propose methods to tag and monitor disaster-related spending within the public finance management cycle. Deliverable: A draft National Disaster Risk Financing Strategy with a framework for tagging disaster-related spending.

hire_title: Climate-Health Vulnerability Assessment for HTM Programme
hire_description:
We are a Singapore-based health programme organisation addressing HIV, Tuberculosis and Malaria (HTM) and need to integrate climate resilience into our work. Rising temperatures and extreme weather are disrupting essential services, but we lack the data to understand how these hazards specifically impact our disease control efforts. We need an independent specialist to conduct a climate and health vulnerability assessment for our local HTM programming. The work must follow World Health Organization (WHO) guidance on vulnerability and adaptation assessments, combining climate and epidemiological data to identify priority risks and gaps in our current capacity.

Deliverable: written vulnerability assessment report identifying specific climate risks to our HTM services.

hire_title: Develop Interactive Module on Global Education Finance Data
hire_description: A Singapore-based multilateral development organisation is launching a professional development academy for policy makers. One core module on global education finance data is incomplete. The specialist needs to write the content covering why global finance data is important, key data sources, and national education accounts. The content must be adapted for an asynchronous online format, including quizzes, real-data exercises, and reflection opportunities. The module should take approximately two hours to complete. Deliverable: written module content and learning approach specification.

hire_title: State-of-knowledge review on electricity supply
hire_description: A Singapore-based statutory board is seeking to refine its energy investment strategy and reduce resource misallocation risk. We need an independent specialist to author a single, high-quality state-of-knowledge review paper focused strictly on electricity supply systems. The paper must synthesise existing literature and data to address critical evidence gaps, ensuring findings are directly usable for policy decisions by decision-makers. Deliverable: one comprehensive research paper on electricity supply evidence.

hire_title: Structure Literature Review for Corruption Costing Methodology
hire_description: I work with a global health body developing a methodology to cost the impact of corruption in health systems. We need a structured literature review to map differing estimation approaches, data sources, and corruption typologies. This evidence base will inform the subsequent top-down modelling of global loss across health system functions. You should complement the review with key informant interviews to validate findings and identify further data sources. Deliverable: a structured literature review report detailing estimation approaches and validated data sources.

hire_title: Assess Aid Transparency Trends and Data Use for Grant Strategy
hire_description: We are a Singapore-based international development foundation supporting transparency in aid delivery. We need someone to review current aid transparency practices and data use, focusing on how transparency efforts are evolving and whether they lead to real-world impact. The specialist will conduct a literature review, analyse key aid data systems like IATI and OECD–DAC, and use automated media tracking via Media Cloud to monitor public references to aid transparency. They will also synthesise insights from interviews with data providers and users in selected countries. Deliverable: a concise report summarising current trends, gaps, and implications for future grant-making.

hire_title: Review MIS Data Flow for Cash Transfer Programme
hire_description:
I manage social protection operations for a government agency transitioning a cash transfer programme to full state ownership. Our Management Information System needs a technical review to ensure data flows and system integration support this transition. We need an assessment of current data handling and recommendations for improvements.

Deliverable: A technical review report with specific recommendations for improving data flow and system integration.

hire_title: Qualitative Data Collection for Refugee Protection Evaluation
hire_description: We are assessing how a refugee protection programme in Pakistan has adapted to recent mobility restrictions under the Illegal Foreign Refugee Plan. We need a specialist to conduct primary qualitative data collection in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa and Balochistan. This involves designing and running Key Informant Interviews (KIIs) and Focus Group Discussions (FGDs) with refugee elders, partners, and government counterparts. You must apply trauma-informed approaches to ensure safety and confidentiality for high-risk groups, including undocumented individuals. Deliverable: a set of compiled and anonymised qualitative transcripts and field notes.

hire_title: Review Oil Sector Governance Practices in Nigeria
hire_description: A Singapore-based international development organisation supporting government reform in the oil sector needs an expert to review governance practices in Nigeria’s extractive industries. The work involves analysing existing policies, identifying gaps in transparency and accountability, and assessing the impact of recent reforms. The specialist will focus on the Petroleum Industry Governance Bill and its alignment with the Nigeria Natural Resource Charter’s 12 precepts. Deliverable: a concise report evaluating governance improvements since 2014, highlighting progress on transparency, monitoring, and participation, with recommendations for strengthening oversight.

hire_title: Political Economy Analysis of Oil Revenue Reform
hire_description: We are a Singapore-based policy research institute working on extractive industries governance. We need a specialist to conduct a focused political economy analysis of the oil sector’s revenue management landscape. The goal is to identify specific 'pockets of effectiveness'—key institutions or individuals with the potential to catalyse pro-reform changes. This involves scanning the current institutional landscape to assess where targeted technical assistance or grants would best support the strengthening of laws, policies, and oversight systems. Deliverable: a strategic analysis report identifying these key players and institutions, with recommendations for targeted support.

hire_title: Contribution Analysis for Rural MSME Programme Evaluation
hire_description: We are a Singapore-based development consultancy supporting an international donor in assessing a rural economic growth programme. We need a specialist to conduct a Contribution Analysis of the programme's impact on micro, small, and medium-sized enterprises (MSMEs). The work involves testing the intervention logic and underlying assumptions to assess the programme's contribution to strengthening the enabling environment for rural enterprises. This should use a mixed-methods approach, including key informant interviews, focus group discussions, and a desk review of secondary data. Deliverable: a written report applying OECD-DAC and EU evaluation criteria, specifically focusing on contribution to MSME growth.

hire_title: Design Research Protocol for Family Planning Demand-Side Intervention
hire_description: A Singapore-based international development organisation is supporting a family planning initiative in Southeast Asia and needs to design a research protocol to evaluate a demand-side intervention. The specialist must define research objectives, select appropriate quantitative methods, develop data collection tools, and outline ethical review requirements. The work must align with the organisation’s focus on scalable, evidence-based family planning solutions. Deliverable: research protocol document including methodology, data collection instruments, and ethical compliance plan.

hire_title: Review KPI Measurement Approaches for Education Framework
hire_description: A Singapore-based government agency needs a technical review of the 12 Key Performance Indicators in our new Girls’ Education Results Framework. We need you to assess the strengths and limitations of each provisional indicator, distinguishing between those trackable via global sources and those requiring annual country-level reporting. Deliverable: a written commentary on each KPI with recommendations for feasible measurement approaches.

hire_title: Design performance indicators for primary health pilot
hire_description: A Singapore-based statutory board or town council managing community health initiatives needs to establish a results-based financing model for a single pilot health facility. The organisation requires a specialist to define clear performance indicators and set measurable targets that align with current primary care standards. The work involves reviewing existing service delivery data and consulting with facility staff to ensure the metrics are realistic and drive the desired health outcomes. Deliverable: written set of performance indicators and target definitions for the pilot facility.

hire_title: Independent Value for Money Evaluation
hire_description:
We operate a sovereign disaster insurance initiative in Singapore, pooling regional climate risk to help member states plan for extreme weather events. We need an independent evaluation of our Value for Money (VFM) to assess the efficiency and sustainability of our current contingency planning and capacity development services.
The specialist must apply a theory-based evaluation framework, using contribution analysis to map our Theory of Change from inputs to impact. This involves reviewing organisational performance and identifying strategic shortcomings in how we deliver risk pooling support.
Deliverable: Final report with VFM assessment and strategic recommendations.

hire_title: Independent verification of one education DLI claim
hire_description: A Singapore-based government statutory board manages a results-based education funding programme where grants are released only after Disbursement-linked Indicators (DLIs) are achieved. We need a specialist to independently verify the evidence quality for one specific annual DLI claim, using a structured assessment covering accuracy, completeness, and feasibility against agreed scoring criteria. Deliverable: written technical scorecard and verification report for the single DLI.

hire_title: Design Risk-Based KYC Framework for Commercial Banking
hire_description: We are a Singapore-based regional commercial bank looking to expand our deposit base without increasing compliance exposure. Our current know-your-customer (KYC) onboarding process creates too much friction, causing unnecessary client touchpoints and slowing down account openings. We need a specialist to redesign our commercial customer lifecycle management, specifically focusing on the KYC collection and verification steps. The work involves analyzing our existing onboarding workflow, identifying high-risk client types (we handle over 50 distinct heightened-risk categories), and developing a flexible risk-based framework that allows for smarter, targeted due diligence rather than blanket requirements. Deliverable: a documented risk-based KYC framework and a working prototype or blueprint for a streamlined data collection tool.

hire_title: Assess revenue recognition process data requirements
hire_description: A Singapore-based global insurance brokerage is struggling with outdated enterprise systems that make it difficult to estimate revenue accurately. The current setup, built for compliance, is no longer sustainable for growth. The task is to conduct a focused assessment of the revenue recognition process to identify the specific data elements needed for accurate modeling. This involves reviewing current workflows to pinpoint gaps and defining the core data requirements that will support future financial insights. Deliverable: a documented list of the identified core data elements essential for the new revenue model.

hire_title: Supply Chain Cost Optimization Analysis for Rug Acquisition
hire_description: We are a Singapore-based rug retailer finalising the acquisition of a major competitor. We need a specialist to analyse our combined supply chain data to identify immediate cost savings in freight and sourcing. Focus specifically on vendor consolidation and a revised sourcing strategy that mirrors our successful 70% freight reduction and 114% sourcing savings elsewhere. The goal is to define actionable steps that exceed standard diligence estimates. Deliverable: a cost optimization report detailing the freight consolidation and sourcing strategy.

hire_title: Analyse Carrier Mix for Commission Optimisation
hire_description: Our Singapore-based insurance firm is adjusting to a centralised servicing model for personal and small commercial lines. As we review our sales and servicing approach, we need to identify where current carrier compensation structures are leaving money on the table. The work involves analysing current-state metrics to surface hidden inefficiencies and missed opportunities in carrier commission. We are looking for a clear view on how optimising the carrier mix can unlock potential upside, specifically targeting the reported opportunity of approximately S$31 million in commission improvement. Deliverable: a quantified analysis of carrier mix optimisation opportunities and the resulting commission potential.

hire_title: Map and design treasury service journey for nCino implementation
hire_description: We are a Singapore-based treasury operations team within a large retail bank, modernising our client service processes using nCino. We need a specialist to map our existing client experience for one core service line and design a streamlined, client-centric service journey. The work involves analysing current pain points and redundancies to define a future-state workflow that eliminates unnecessary handoffs and prepares the platform for configuration. Deliverable: written service journey map with a prioritised list of process improvements and workflow design for one treasury service stream.

hire_title: Discovery sessions for commercial lending workflow
hire_description: Conduct 41 discovery sessions to capture 579 functional and 28 technical requirements for a commercial lending workflow. The goal is to identify current process bottlenecks and data entry duplication across nine loan lifecycle stages. This work will inform the subsequent design of an nCino and Salesforce solution. Deliverable: consolidated requirements document mapping functional and technical needs.

hire_title: Digital diligence for PE-backed HVAC services bid
hire_description:
A Singapore-based PE firm is preparing for a competitive bid for a residential services platform and needs to validate post-close value before the deal closes. The specialist will apply AI and data analytics tools to analyze sales and operational performance at scale, simulating future-state scenarios to quantify revenue and efficiency opportunities. The work covers digital drivers across marketing, booking, and operational efficiency, replacing traditional diligence with data-backed insights to support aggressive but defensible financial assumptions.

Deliverable: pro-forma financial model with quantified value levers and a prioritized value creation roadmap.

hire_title: Prioritize Generative AI Use Cases for Service
hire_description: I lead service operations at a Singapore-based food and beverage company. We need to identify which generative AI applications will actually improve our customer and field service interactions. I need you to run a workshop session to brainstorm potential ideas, then filter them down to the top eight based on projected ROI for productivity, revenue, and customer satisfaction. Focus specifically on use cases like AI chat assistants to boost first-call resolution and sentiment analysis for outreach. Deliverable: a prioritized list of the top eight AI use cases with estimated ROI for each.

hire_title: Alteryx Sales Account Strategy Analysis
hire_description: Optimize account strategy for a Singapore-based optical frames manufacturer to increase revenue from existing accounts. Analyze 10 million B2B sales transactions using Alteryx to correlate customer demographics with sales activity. Segment over 20,000 accounts into distinct service tiers (e.g., high-touch vs. digital) to recommend an optimal sales representative headcount per region. Deliverable: prioritized account segmentation model and recommended sales rep allocation plan.

hire_title: Design Mobile App Wireframes for Virtual Care
hire_description: We are a Singapore-based primary care provider looking to launch a virtual care platform to reach 400,000 additional patients. We need a specialist to design the user experience and wireframes for our new iOS and Android mobile applications. The goal is to create an intuitive digital experience that improves patient engagement and supports our new virtual care offering. Deliverable: a set of high-fidelity mobile app wireframes and UX flows for iOS and Android.
